data.title: Configuration Manager (m/w/d)
data.description:
Would you like to work on exciting space projects and be directly involved in the development of space reflectors for different missions? Are you driven by hands-on challenges and precision engineering? Do you want to be part of a diverse, dynamic team that shares your passion for space?

Then LSS is the right place for you!

We are at the forefront of European innovation in deployable antenna reflector technologies, serving both domestic and international markets. We are looking for a Configuration Manager (m/w/d) with a background in space engineering to support our team. As a Configuration Manager, you will safeguard the consistency, traceability, and controlled evolution of product configurations throughout the development and delivery of complex space systems.

Your Tasks

  • Own the configuration management process across the complete product lifecycle, ensuring compliance with ECSS and company standards.

  • Develop, implement and continuously improve configuration management policies, procedures and strategies in compliance with ECSS, ISO and applicable customer requirements.

  • Establish and maintain configuration baselines, version control and configuration status accounting for all product and design data.

  • Lead change management activities, including Change Control Boards (CCB), Engineering Change Requests (CR), Requests for Deviation (RFD) and Requests for Waiver (RFW), ensuring robust impact assessment and traceability.

  • Manage configuration and technical data within ERP/PLM/PDM systems, ensuring accuracy, integrity and accessibility.

  • Ensure end-to-end traceability between requirements, as designed configuration, released products and as built configuration.

  • Ensure consistency between released technical documentation and participate in review / release processes.

  • Generate configuration metrics, reports and status updates to support reviews, audits and management decision-making.

Your Profile

  • Master’s Degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Systems Engineering or similar field.

  • 5+ years of experience in Configuration management, preferably in ESA projects.

  • Strong understanding of system engineering and product lifecycle and experience with hardware configuration control.

  • Strong understanding of both the overall system architecture, detailed subsystem interactions, detailed designs and manufacturing.

  • Familiarity with space project phases (Phase 0/A → F) gained in the European space industry

  • Knowledge of ECSS standards (especially CM, PA/QA and System Engineering)

  • High attention to detail and structured and analytical thinking

  • Ability to quickly understand complex technical systems and their dependencies.

  • Strong documentation, communication and time management skills

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken);

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Apps, DOORS and other required software

  • Strong team spirit and ability to interface effectively with multidisciplinary teams and international partners

Your Benefits

  • A challenging, fast-paced position at the forefront of space technology.

  • Scope for individual development and growth in a growing multicultural team of discipline experts.

  • Flexible working hours with the core time.

  • A relaxed working environment with a flat hierarchy combined with a motivated and open team.

  • Casual dress code.

  • Open ear for all kinds of concerns.

data.title: (Senior) Backend Engineer – Golang
data.description:
The essentials

Team: Product & Engineering

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Berlin — hybrid, 3 days in the office

Working language: English (German: a plus)

Salary band: Shared before your first interview

Your impact

As (Senior) Backend Engineer at Gymondo, you build and improve the scalable backend systems that power our platform for hundreds of thousands of active users. You work with a modern tech stack, establish new services using clean architecture principles, and help translate legacy concepts into maintainable, future-proof code. Your work directly shapes the technical foundation that enables Gymondo to grow — reliably, efficiently and at scale.

What you’ll drive

  • You build, improve and maintain scalable backend services using Golang and Gin-Gonic, following clean architecture and established design patterns

  • You design and implement REST APIs following OpenAPI standards, with a focus on clarity, reliability and long-term maintainability

  • You contribute to our microservice architecture — working on reliability, scaling, stateless applications and event-driven systems

  • You rebuild legacy concepts and translate them into well-known programming patterns with transparent and maintainable business logic

  • You develop data-driven features and are involved in all stages of the development process — from design to deployment

  • You work on our scalable, automated infrastructure using AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform

  • You participate in peer code reviews, write unit tests and champion agile development practices

  • You share knowledge, discuss better solutions openly and grow together with the team

What defines you

Must-have

  • 4+ years of professional experience in backend-focused development, including infrastructure

  • 3+ years contributing to microservice architectures with a focus on reliability, scaling, stateless applications, event-driven systems and clean architecture

  • 3+ years designing REST APIs following OpenAPI standards

  • Proven hands-on experience with Golang and Gin-Gonic

  • Ability to design proof of concepts and prototypes

  • Standardised coding practices: peer code reviews, unit testing and a preference for agile development

  • An open mindset and genuine interest in state-of-the-art technologies and methodologies

  • Fluent English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with JVM languages (Kotlin / Java) and frameworks such as Ktor, Spring or Node.js

  • A Product Engineer mindset: balancing technical excellence with business impact, proactively identifying trade-offs that prioritise user value and speed-to-market without compromising long-term system health

  • Strong communication skills across the Product & Engineering team and additional stakeholders

  • A collaborative, humble approach — you promote good relationships in your guild and are always willing to learn from others

Our tech stack

Golang, Kotlin, Node.js, Java 17 · Gin-Gonic, Ktor, NestJS, Spring Boot · Elasticsearch, MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis · Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes · Event-Driven Architecture · AWS

Benefits

Success requires positive energy. That's why we ensure the right conditions are in place — physically, mentally, and within the team:

  • 🏖️ 30 days of vacation per year + Christmas Eve & New Year's Eve as additional paid days off

  • 🏠 Hybrid working model — 60% in the office, 40% from home, applicable to all working hours

  • 🌍 Up to 4 weeks of work from abroad per year (Berlin-based roles)

  • 🏋️ Free Urban Sports Club M membership & access to Nilo Health for mental health and personal development

  • 📱 Free access to 7Mind, Gymondo & Buddyfit — our own digital wellbeing products

  • 🚲 €30 monthly mobility budget via Navit

  • 📚 €1,000 annual training budget + a wide range of opportunities for personal growth and development

  • 👨👩👧 Family-friendly benefits — childcare costs & paid sick days for children

  • 🍎 The office classics — fruit & vegetable basket, muesli & yogurt (also vegan), drinks & snacks

  • 🐶 Pet-friendly office — four-legged colleagues are very welcome!

These benefits apply to full-time and part-time permanent employees. Working students and interns receive a pro-rated selection.

People who make things happen

Gymondo is one of the leading digital fitness and nutrition platforms in the DACH region — with over 2,000 workouts, holistic training programmes and smart nutrition plans. As part of 7NXT Health Group, we help millions of people make movement a lasting part of their everyday lives.

Our team pushes each other, thinks critically and grows together. We take responsibility — for our users, our products and our planet.

Everyone counts

We welcome what makes you unique.

At Gymondo we believe in diversity, openness and team spirit. No matter which gender you identify with, whether you have a disability, what your neurotype is, where you come from, what you believe in or how you love — you are welcome here.

Du beherrschst das echte Filmhandwerk an Kamera, Licht und Set, brennst aber genauso dafür, die Grenzen der Content-Produktion durch generative Video-KI neu zu definieren? Du denkst Bewegtbild nicht entweder-oder, sondern verbindest Realdrehs und modernste AI-Workflows zu einer einzigartigen visuellen Markenwelt? In unserem Studio in Bonn verbindest du physische Set-Produktion mit State-of-the-Art AI-Video-Tools – zukunftsorientiert, datengetrieben und auf echtem Greenfield-Niveau!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Studio-Videoproduktion: Du konzipierst und realisierst hochwertige Produkt- und Lifestyle-Videos für Teppiche, Decken, Kissen und Wohnaccessoires. Du arbeitest mit echten Produkten, realen Interior-Sets und professioneller Lichtsetzung in unserem Studio.

  • Hybrid-Filmmaking: Du kombinierst klassischen Realfilm nahtlos mit generativen Workflows, erweiterst oder veränderst bestehendes Material mit KI und findest immer die perfekte Balance zwischen Set-Dreh und AI.
  • Schnitt & Postproduktion: Du übernimmst die eigenständige Nachbearbeitung – vom Rohschnitt über Color Grading bis hin zum finalen Export.
  • Performance- & Social-Content: Du produzierst informativen Produkt-Content, Social-Media-Clips und Werbemittel. Briefings und Performance-Learnings setzt du gemeinsam mit Marketing und Creative zügig in neue Varianten um.
  • Kreative Konzeptentwicklung & Workflow-Innovation: Du entwickelst Videoideen von der ersten Skizze bis zum finalen Asset. Zudem testest du fortlaufend neue AI-Video-Tools, etablierst smarte Workflows und sicherst eine markenkonforme, ästhetische Bildsprache.

Hinweis zur Stelle: Wir besetzen diese Position ausschließlich in Festanstellung (eine freiberufliche oder projektbasierte Zusammenarbeit ist nicht vorgesehen). Als Office-First-Company arbeiten wir überwiegend vor Ort in unserem HQ in Bonn.

Stellenanforderungen

Dein Profil

  • Filmmaking-Fundament: Du bringst eine Ausbildung, ein Studium oder relevante Praxiserfahrung in Film, Videoproduktion, Mediengestaltung oder Content Creation mit – idealerweise mit Erfahrung im Marken-, E-Commerce-, Interior- oder Fashion-Umfeld.

  • Hybrid-Mindset & Ästhetik: Du verstehst, wann ein echter Dreh sinnvoller ist und wann KI Prozessvorteile bringt. Ein exzellentes Gespür für Licht, Farbe, Timing und Interior-Design zeichnet dich aus.
  • Performance-Verständnis: Du setzt Briefings für unterschiedliche Hooks, Längen und plattformspezifische Formate (TikTok, Meta Ads, Webshop) sicher um.
  • Teamplayer & Präsenz: Du schätzt die enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Creative-, Foto- und Marketing-Team. Die physische Präsenz in unserem Studio in Bonn ist für dich selbstverständlich.

Deine Benefits

Ab Mitte 2027 ziehen wir in unseren brandneuen, hochmodernen Unternehmenscampus, der genau darauf ausgelegt ist, dass die Arbeit vor Ort Spaß macht - mit State-of-the-Art-Arbeitsplätzen, modernen Meetingräumen und viel Platz für echten Team-Spirit.

  • Zeit für Erholung: Du erhältst 28 Tage Urlaub und profitierst von unserem flexiblen Gleitzeitmodell. Weihnachten und Silvester sind bei uns grundsätzlich arbeitsfreie Tage, die nicht von deinem Urlaubskonto abgehen.

Seit 2008 revolutionieren wir von Bonn aus den europäischen Teppich- und Home-&-Living-E-Commerce. Mit über 100 Millionen Euro Umsatz, modernster AI-gestützter Produktinszenierung und Kunden in 17 Ländern verbinden wir die Sicherheit eines etablierten Marktführers mit dem Drive und den flachen Hierarchien eines Digital-Pioneers. data.title: Founding Engineer (Remote - EEA/UK)
data.description:
Founding Engineer


Role can be based remotely in the EEA or hybrid in our London or Munich offices.

Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us.

About Tarebase

We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it.

Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people.

Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us.

About you

The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on.

You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build.

You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes.

You use coding agents effectively, but stay close to the code. You know their limitations in a large codebase, review and challenge their work, and take testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation seriously. You can design useful tests and evaluations, manage complexity, and tell when something is genuinely ready to ship.

You also enjoy digging into challenging problems. You keep up with what current models, agent harnesses and research make possible, and you can judge what actually works for a given use case. You know how to build agents and AI workflows into a product and use evaluations, validation and deterministic logic to make what they produce consistent and verifiable. You're comfortable extracting structure from messy documents and care a lot about data quality. You experiment, measure the results, question your assumptions, and keep going until you've found a solution that really holds up.

You can turn that work into shipped software, taking a product idea or technical direction through design and implementation without waiting for someone to assign you a ticket. We work remotely, so clear communication and follow-through matter a lot to us. We value people who manage their own work, can be counted on, and raise important issues early.

How to apply

Apply with the button on this page.

Please ensure to use a hand-written CV. We read every application ourselves. It's fine to use tools for spelling or translation, but we want to hear your voice.

Our process

The process should take a few weeks from start to finish depending on your availability.

  1. Application review. If we love your resume we will send over some short questions.

  2. Intro call with Dom and Felix. An informal conversation about the role, the technology and what you're looking for.

  3. Technical deep dive with Felix. We talk briefly about a system you’ve worked on (no need to share anything confidential), then work through a system design problem together.

  4. Half a day with us in Munich or London. We cover your travel, hotel if needed, and meals. You spend about two hours on a made-up task similar to the problems we work on, using your usual tools and coding agents. Then we have lunch, go through your work together, and talk through a customer scenario.

  5. References and offer. We speak with 1-2 people you've worked with (only with your agreement) and aim to decide within 48 hours.

If we don't move forward after the technical conversation or later, we'll share some feedback with you.

Compensation: €100.000–120.000 base salary plus 0.75–1% equity

Setup: A MacBook Pro and whatever else you need to work well. If you'd rather not work from home, we'll pay for a coworking space near you.

Location: Munich or London, or remote within Europe (GMT-1 to GMT+3) with regular meet-ups.

data.title: Technical Application & Integration Specialist (m/w/d)
data.description:
Wir suchen eine technisch versierte Persönlichkeit, die gerne selbst Probleme untersucht, Kundenanforderungen versteht und gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam Lösungen umsetzt. Dabei sind uns analytisches Denken, praktische Erfahrung und Eigeninitiative wichtiger als formale Projektmanagement-Zertifikate oder Führungserfahrung.

Komm zu ubinam – einem Unternehmen der Kienzle Automotive Gruppe. Wir entwickeln und betreiben Telematik- und SaaS-Lösungen für Geschäftskunden aus Automotive, Transport & Logistik, Bau und Entsorgung.

Unsere Lösungen verbinden Fahrzeuge, mobile Endgeräte, Tracking-Plattformen und IT-Systeme und bringen digitale Geschäftsprozesse in die Praxis.

Als Technical Application & Integration Specialist (m/w/d) bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Softwareentwicklung und unserer Plattform. Du übersetzt Anforderungen in technische Lösungen, testest neue Funktionen und gehst technischen Fragen auf den Grund.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreust technische Kunden- und Integrationsprojekte – von der Anforderung bis zur Umsetzung.

  • Du analysierst Kundenprozesse und übersetzt sie in klare technische Anforderungen für unser externes Softwareentwicklungsteam.

  • Du definierst Testfälle, testest neue Funktionen und übernimmst deren Validierung und Abnahme.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Entwicklern und technischen Partnern zusammen.

  • Du analysierst technische Probleme und unterstützt bei komplexen Support- und Fehlerfällen.

  • Du bindest bei Bedarf On-Board-Units, Tablets und Smartphones in das Zusammenspiel mit unserer Plattform ein.

  • Du entwickelst wiederverwendbare Lösungen, Standards und Testverfahren, um Fehler zu vermeiden.

  • Du dokumentierst technische Zusammenhänge und sorgst für einen nachhaltigen Wissenstransfer.

  • Du wirkst aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung unserer Plattform und Prozesse mit.

Das bringst du mit

Du musst kein klassischer Softwareentwickler sein. Uns ist wichtig, dass du technische Zusammenhänge verstehst, analytisch denkst und gerne Lösungen findest.

  • Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis und Freude daran, dich in vernetzte Systeme einzuarbeiten

  • Erfahrung mit Softwaretests, Fehleranalyse, Systemintegration oder technischem Projektmanagement

  • Die Fähigkeit, Kundenanforderungen zu verstehen und in klare technische Anforderungen zu übersetzen

  • Eine strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Softwareentwicklern

  • Eigeninitiative und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse; Ungarisch- und Rumänischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

Technisch hilfreich: Kenntnisse in REST APIs, JSON/XML, EDI, SQL, Datenbanken, Log-Analyse, SaaS-Systemen oder Scripting. Auch Erfahrung mit Telematik, Fahrzeugdaten, mobilen Android-Geräten oder KI ist willkommen.

Programmierkenntnisse sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist, dass du technische Zusammenhänge verstehst, Anforderungen präzise beschreiben und entwickelte Lösungen zuverlässig testen und beurteilen kannst.

Benefits

So läuft es bei ubinam

  • Kleine Teams, kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit Kunden und unserem Softwareentwicklungsteam zusammen.

  • Technik zum Anfassen: Von der Software über Smartphone und Tablet bis zur Telematik-Hardware im Fahrzeug – du kannst unsere Lösungen selbst ausprobieren und verstehen.

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bekommst Verantwortung und kannst technische Lösungen und Prozesse aktiv mitentwickeln.

  • Abwechslungsreiche Projekte: Unterschiedliche Kunden, Anforderungen und technische Herausforderungen sorgen dafür, dass es nicht langweilig wird.

  • Moderne Arbeitsweisen: Wir entwickeln unsere Plattform und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter und setzen moderne Tools und KI dort ein, wo sie echten Mehrwert schaffen.

  • Gemeinsam besser werden: Wir setzen auf Dokumentation, Wissenstransfer und wiederverwendbare Lösungen statt auf Wissen in einzelnen Köpfen.

  • Echte Wirkung: Was du entwickelst und verbesserst, wird später bei echten Kunden und in echten Fahrzeugen eingesetzt.

Dein Bonus bei uns

  • 32–40 Stunden pro Woche – flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Hybrides Arbeiten nach erfolgreicher Einarbeitung

  • Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Moderne Arbeitsausstattung

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Projekt?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Bewirb dich jetzt als Technical Application & Integration Specialist (m/w/d) bei ubinam.

data.title: Junior Customer Success Specialist (m/f/x)
data.description:
Your mission

Purpose of the role

The Junior Customer Success Manager keeps single-store restaurants live, transacting and growing on SIDES. The role works a large book of scaled accounts, mostly through campaigns and signals rather than scheduled calls, and steps in personally when something moves: a store goes silent, a termination arrives, a customer becomes eligible for an upgrade.

It is the entry point into Customer Success. The role is built so that someone new to SaaS can learn the craft on clear processes, and grow into owning a book of their own.

Key responsibilities:

Activation and activity:

  • Follow up on new accounts from onboarding handover until they transact regularly, with a focus on the first 90 days
  • Work the silent-store list every week: accounts that are online in the CRM but show no transactions
  • Help customers adopt the modules they already pay for

Retention:

  • Contact every customer in the book whose termination arrives, within two working days, and document the reason
  • Run the first save conversation using the save playbook (pause, downgrade, fee removal, technical fix, discount last) and hand complex cases to a senior colleague
  • Clear the termination date in the CRM when a save succeeds

Expansion:

  • Run the evergreen upsell campaigns on the book together with Marketing, and follow up on responses
  • Qualify interest in SIDES Pay, webshop, loyalty and driver modules and close standard upgrades
  • Use tier and rate changes as the entry point for an upsell conversation

Day to day:

  • Answer customer success enquiries on the book in Zoho Desk and the CRM, and route pure support issues to Support without taking them over
  • Keep every interaction documented in the CRM
  • Flag recurring product issues to the Team Lead with ticket references

Your profile

Required:

  • First experience in a customer-facing role: customer success, account management, inside sales, support or hospitality
  • Clear, friendly and persistent on the phone
  • Organised enough to work a large book through lists and signals
  • Comfortable with a CRM and with numbers
  • Fluent German (DACH book) or Dutch (BENELUX book), good English

Desirable:

  • Experience in restaurants, delivery or retail
  • First experience with a SaaS product or payment product

Perks & Benefits

Arbeiten, wo Wohn- und Arbeitswelten zu Leidenschaft werden.

Seit vielen Jahren stehen wir als familiengeführtes Einrichtungsunternehmen für Interior-Design, exklusive Designermöbel und individuelle ganzheitliche Beratung auf höchstem Niveau.

Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der Innenarchitektur und hochwertigen Einrichtung, ob Business, In- oder Outdoor. Unser Anspruch ist es, unsere KundInnen dabei jederzeit in den Mittelpunkt zu stellen.

Aufgaben

  • Social Media weiterdenken: Du entwickelst unsere Social-Media-Präsenz für B2B- und B2C-Zielgruppen kontinuierlich weiter und übersetzt unsere Marke in relevante digitale Formate.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung im Social-Media-Management, Content Marketing oder Digital Marketing und kannst zeigen, welche Kanäle, Formate oder Marken du bereits betreut und weiterentwickelt hast.
  • Du verstehst Social Media als professionellen Kommunikations- und Marketingkanal und nicht ausschließlich als Plattform für einzelne Posts.
  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für hochwertigen Content, Bildsprache, Storytelling und Markenästhetik.
  • Du interessierst dich für Interior Design, Architektur, Gestaltung und Lifestyle und kannst dich in die visuelle Welt einer Premium-Marke hineinversetzen.
  • Du kannst Content nicht nur konzipieren, sondern auch ins Machen kommen, selbst produzieren, koordinieren, veröffentlichen und konsequent weiterentwickeln.
  • Du verstehst die unterschiedlichen Anforderungen von B2B- und B2C-Kommunikation und kannst Inhalte entsprechend übersetzen.
  • Du kennst die Mechanismen und Formate relevanter Plattformen wie Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok und YouTube und weißt, dass nicht jeder Content auf jedem Kanal funktioniert.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen.

  • Du erstellst schnell unterschiedliche Varianten und optimierst unter anderem Einstieg, Länge, Bildfolge, Captions, Sound und Call-to-Action.

  • Du adaptierst Videos für unterschiedliche Plattformen, Formate, Zielgruppen und Märkte.

Alternativ kannst du mit Wellpass deutschlandweit auf über 8.000 Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote zugreifen – online oder vor Ort – und profitierst dabei von unserem attraktiven Firmenrabatt.

data.title: SAP Inhouse Consultant CO (m/f/d)
data.description:
About the Role

Our client, a leading international company, is looking for an experienced SAP Inhouse Consultant CO (m/f/d) to join its team and drive the continuous development and optimisation of its SAP Controlling environment.

This role is ideal for an SAP CO professional with strong process knowledge, a hands-on mindset and experience in project or sub-project management. You will work closely with international business units, key users and cross-functional teams to optimise business processes and support the transformation of the company's SAP landscape.

Candidates with 2–3 years of SAP FI/CO consulting experience are also encouraged to apply, provided they have a clear interest in specialising in SAP CO.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise and support international business units and Global Business Services in optimising, standardising and transforming the SAP landscape, with a particular focus on Controlling.
  • Lead or co-lead national and international SAP CO projects, including implementation and rollout activities.
  • Take end-to-end responsibility for the SAP CO module and drive its continuous development in line with business requirements.
  • Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for process improvement, standardisation and efficiency gains.
  • Develop technical solution concepts and independently implement them through SAP Customizing.
  • Plan, coordinate and manage SAP testing activities.
  • Act as the central point of contact between key users, business departments and related SAP modules, including SAP MM, SD, PS, PP and CS.
  • Provide third-level support, resolve complex issues and coordinate with external service providers.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development and optimisation of SAP CO functionalities and processes.

Your Profile

  • A degree in Computer Science, Business Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration or a comparable qualification.
  • Several years of experience in SAP CO, ideally with at least 2–3 years of project or sub-project management experience.
  • Strong knowledge of relevant SAP CO modules and functionalities, particularly:
  • Product Cost Controlling (CO-PC)
  • Actual Costing and Material Ledger (CO-PC-ACT)
  • Overhead Cost Controlling (CO-OM)
  • Profitability Analysis (CO-PA)
  • Profit Center Accounting (EC-PCA)
  • Experience in designing, implementing and managing SAP projects.
  • Ideally, initial experience with SAP S/4HANA and basic knowledge of related modules such as SAP PP, MM or SD.
  • Business-fluent German and English skills, with the ability to communicate confidently with stakeholders at all organisational levels.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a solid understanding of business processes.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach, strong communication skills and the ability to drive topics forward.
  • A collaborative mindset and the confidence to take ownership and lead initiatives.

Important: We are particularly interested in candidates who combine technical SAP knowledge with strong business process expertise and leadership potential. This is not a pure development role.

What Our Client Offers

  • Flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home on selected days.
  • A family-friendly working environment, including support for childcare and family care arrangements.
  • Public transport subsidies and attractive bicycle or car leasing schemes.
  • Employer contributions to a company pension scheme, with the option to make additional personal contributions.
  • Comprehensive training and professional development opportunities.
  • A collaborative international working environment with opportunities to contribute to strategic SAP projects.

data.title: Senior Product Analyst (w/m/d)
data.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir suchen eine:n Senior Product Analyst, der/die analytische Präzision mit einem ausgeprägten Produktgespür verbindet. Du entscheidest auf Basis von Daten. Du wirst echte Nutzerprobleme auf Grundlage qualitativer und quantitativer Daten herausarbeiten, eine Einschätzung dazu entwickeln, was sich ändern sollte, das passende Experiment aufsetzen und die Ergebnisse selbst analysieren.

Du bist Teil eines Product-Teams, das sich auf einen Teil der User Journey fokussiert, und arbeitest eng mit der Person zusammen, die für diesen Bereich verantwortlich ist, sowie mit den Entwickler:innen, die daran bauen. Du schließt dich einer Gruppe von Conversion Analysts im Unternehmen an, die genauso arbeiten, und bringst eine Perspektive und Erfahrung mit, von der das gesamte Team lernen wird.

Unser Produkt ist ausschließlich für den deutschsprachigen Markt. Um unsere Nutzer:innen wirklich zu verstehen und für sie zu gestalten, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse unerlässlich. Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im Team sind ebenfalls erforderlich.

Das wirst du konkret tun:

  • Das eigentliche Problem identifizieren, bevor du es löst. In quantitative und qualitative Daten eintauchen, bis du die wirkliche Frage hinter dem Auftrag findest. Sie dann verständlich und handlungsleitend machen. Ein gut formuliertes Problem ist die halbe Lösung.
  • Das Experiment aufsetzen, ehrlich lesen und entscheiden, was als nächstes kommt. Eine testbare Veränderung definieren, sie sauber instrumentieren und das Ergebnis analysieren. Dann das Gelernte nutzen, um die nächste Frage zu formulieren. Das schließt ein, auch über Tests zu berichten, die nicht funktioniert haben, und den nächsten Schritt zu gestalten.
  • KI einsetzen und dein Urteil dort einbringen, wo es zählt. KI unterstützt viele unserer ersten Entwürfe. Du wirst sie briefen, hinterfragen und die Qualität sichern – damit deine eigene Zeit für das Denken bleibt, das ein Modell nicht leisten kann.
  • Für das Weglassen argumentieren. Hinzufügen ist einfach. Du wirst mitentscheiden, was seinen Platz verdient und was entfernt werden sollte – und bereit sein, dafür einzustehen.
  • Mit Nachbar:innen sprechen. Experimente sagen dir, was passiert ist – nicht, was Menschen gebraucht hätten. Du wirst echte Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen, die das Produkt nutzen, weil man sich kein Verständnis für andere durch A/B-Tests erarbeiten kann.
  • Erfahrungen gestalten, die auf echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und echtem Nachbarschaftsleben basieren. Dein Job ist es, zu Flows und Screens beizutragen, die intuitiv nutzbar sind und ihren Platz durch messbaren Mehrwert rechtfertigen.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast einen ausgeprägten Produktsinn und arbeitest datengetrieben. Dein Hintergrund kann verschieden sein – Product Analytics, CRO, Growth Engineering, oder eine hybridere Rolle aus Produkt oder Design – solange du weißt, wie man Hypothesen schärft, Experimente aufsetzt und Ergebnisse in Entscheidungen übersetzt.
  • Du hast Experimente von Anfang bis Ende durchgeführt und weißt, wie du von einem zum nächsten kommst: Hypothese aufstellen, starke Varianten entwickeln, die richtigen Metriken festlegen, Ergebnisse analysieren und eine klare Entscheidung treffen – launchen, verwerfen oder iterieren.
  • Du hast technisches Know-how und Erfahrung im Aufsetzen und Auswerten von Experimenten in einem A/B-Testing-Tool sowie im Erstellen der dafür notwendigen Dashboards.
  • Du holst dir deine Zahlen selbst per SQL-Abfrage. Du arbeitest mit Rohdaten, um Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und Chancen zu identifizieren – ohne auf andere warten zu müssen.
  • Du hast statistische Grundkenntnisse. Du musst kein R beherrschen, aber du verstehst, worum es bei Bayesianischer vs. frequentistischer Statistik geht und warum man vor dem Start eines Experiments eine Power-Analyse durchführt.
  • Du präsentierst deine Arbeit klar, verteidigst deine Entscheidungen, wenn sie hinterfragt werden, und bist sicher vor einem Publikum.
  • Du arbeitest routiniert mit KI-Tools. Diese Rolle gibt dir mehr Einfluss und Kontrolle – aber dafür musst du unseren AI-Enablement-Stack nutzen und weiterentwickeln können.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich – du wirst Texte und Flows für deutschsprachige Nutzer:innen gestalten und bewerten.
  • Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im internationalen Team.

Bitte schick uns ein Anschreiben, in dem du erklärst, warum diese Rolle und warum jetzt – und beschreibe mindestens ein Projekt, das du von Anfang bis Ende erläuterst: die Hypothese, was du getestet hast, das Ergebnis und was du daraus mitgenommen hast. Zeig uns, wie du Daten genutzt hast, um dein Denken voranzubringen, und wo Experimente das beeinflusst haben, was du gebaut hast.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das mindestens zwei Bürotage mit Remote-Arbeit kombiniert.
  • Einen sinnstiftenden Job – wir schaffen ein großartiges Produkt mit echtem Mehrwert für die Gemeinschaft
  • Mitarbeit in einem fröhlichen und erfahrenen Team, das sich austauscht und voneinander lernt
  • Einblick in den gesamten Arbeitsprozess unseres Social Startups sowie der Stiftung

data.description:
Über uns

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Seitdem konnten wir das Leben von Millionen Reizdarmpatienten weltweit spürbar verbessern. Heute gehört B. bifidum MIMBb75 zu den am besten erforschten Bakterienstämmen weltweit. Seine Wirksamkeit und sein einzigartiger Wirkmechanismus wurden in zahlreichen klinischen Studien nachgewiesen und publiziert – u.a. in renommierten Fachzeitschriften wie The Lancet.

Wir arbeiten mit führenden Forschungsinstitutionen wie der Charité Berlin zusammen, um die Zusammenhänge zwischen der Mikrobiota (Bakterien in unserem Darm) und Allergien, Hautkrankheiten und psychischen Störungen zu erforschen. Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

Für Dich klingt das spannend? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Mission bei uns

Willst Du im E-Commerce nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern selbst die Hebel finden, die unseren Shop schneller, besser und erfolgreicher machen – mit KI, Automatisierung und sauberem Code? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Als E-Commerce Developer – AI & Automation (w/m/d) verantwortest Du die technische Weiterentwicklung unseres internationalen Shopify-PLUS-Shops über 11 Märkte – von Themes, Apps und Checkout bis zu Schnittstellen und automatisierten Workflows. Dabei denkst Du in Business-Ergebnissen: Was spart Zeit, was steigert die Conversion, was macht unsere Prozesse skalierbar? Ob Du aus der Shopify-Entwicklung, dem technischen E-Commerce oder der Automatisierung kommst: Die Position ist für Trainees bis Seniors offen – entscheidend sind Dein Drive, Deine Lernkurve und Dein Ownership. Hilf uns dabei, Millionen von Menschen mit unseren Probiotika ein längeres und gesünderes Leben zu schenken.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du findest eigenständig die Stellen, an denen im E-Commerce Zeit, Umsatz oder Qualität verloren gehen, und löst sie mit KI, Automatisierung und Code – von der Idee bis zum Rollout.

  • Du setzt KI täglich in Deiner Entwicklung ein, baust AI-Agenten und Tool-Integrationen und bringst funktionierende Lösungen in den produktiven Einsatz.

  • Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für unseren Shopify-PLUS-Shop in 11 Märkten: Themes, Apps, Checkout und Performance.

  • Du entwickelst APIs, Datenflüsse und individuelle Backend-Logik überall dort, wo Standardlösungen nicht ausreichen.

  • Du verbesserst Conversion und Kundenerlebnis datenbasiert – mit A/B-Tests und neuen Kanälen wie TikTok Shop oder WhatsApp.

 

Dein Profil

  • Du hast E-Commerce-Drive: Du willst mit technischen Lösungen Umsatz, Conversion, Customer Experience und Effizienz spürbar verbessern – und misst Dich am Ergebnis, nicht an abgearbeiteten Tickets.

  • Du nutzt KI und Automatisierung bereits praktisch – im Job oder in eigenen Projekten – und kannst zeigen, was dabei entstanden ist. n8n, MCP, APIs und AI-Agenten reizen Dich.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und pragmatisch und übernimmst Verantwortung ohne enge Tagessteuerung. Ob Trainee oder Senior: Unterschiedlich ist die Tiefe, nicht der Anspruch.

Das ist eine operative Hands-on-Rolle für jemanden, der gern organisiert, automatisiert und den Überblick behält für den reibungslosen Ablauf. Wenn du Lust hast, moderne AI-Tools im echten Betrieb einzusetzen und dabei zu lernen, freuen wir uns auf dich.

Als Servicetechniker (m/w/d) für Sicherheitstechnik installierst, programmierst, wartest und reparierst Du moderne Sicherheitsanlagen. Dabei betreust Du abwechslungsreiche Projekte und sorgst für den zuverlässigen Betrieb unserer Systeme.

Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Installation, Programmierung und Inbetriebnahme von Brandmeldeanlagen (BMA), Einbruchmeldeanlagen (EMA), Zutrittskontrollsystemen (ZuKo), Videoüberwachungssystemen sowie Sprachalarmierungs- (SAA) und elektroakustischen Anlagen (ELA)

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Projektleitung und Zulieferern

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Informations- und Kommunikationstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, z. B. als Elektroniker (m/w/d), Informationselektroniker (m/w/d) oder Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration (m/w/d)

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Einbruchmeldeanlagen (EMA), Zutrittskontrollsystemen (ZuKo), Videoüberwachungssystemen, Sprachalarmierungsanlagen (SAA) oder elektroakustischen Anlagen (ELA)

Du musst nicht alle Bereiche bereits beherrschen. Vielleicht liegt Dein Schwerpunkt auf Brandmeldeanlagen oder einem anderen Bereich der Sicherheitstechnik. Wenn Du Dich weiterentwickeln möchtest, begleiten wir Dich mit einer fundierten Einarbeitung und individuellen Weiterbildungen.

data.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

Due to ongoing growth and demand, we’re looking for a Partnerships Manager to build relationships and lead materials design engagements with potential partners in Europe.

  • Early stage, big market. Materials are a trillion-dollar problem, and most R&D organizations are only starting to use AI.

  • You shape it from day one. You'll help decide who we work with, how we go to market and which partnerships make it grow.

What You Will Do

Build the pipeline

  • Identify and reach R&D, materials and chemicals teams at US industrial companies that can benefit from direct access to our AI and data.

  • Own your pipeline end to end, from the first conversation to a signed agreement.

  • Use your network and market knowledge to open doors in key innovation hubs such as the Bay Area, Boston, Texas and the Research Triangle.

Close and grow partnerships

  • Understand each team's materials challenges and turn them into clear, compelling proposals together with our scientists and Technical Program Managers.

  • Negotiate commercial terms and bring agreements to signature.

  • Turn first engagements into lasting relationships, and spot where a partner can do more with us.

Shape how we go to market

  • Help decide which customer types and sectors to focus on first, based on what converts fastest.

  • Bring what you hear in the market back to our product, research and leadership teams.

  • Help build the processes, materials and playbook that the wider team will use as we grow.

  • Represent CuspAI at industry events and conferences.

What We're Looking For

Someone who has sold to or partnered with R&D, chemicals or materials organizations, and who enjoys building something new more than running a process that already works.

  • 8+ years in partnerships, business development or sales roles selling to industrial R&D, materials, chemicals or semiconductor organizations.

  • Experience bringing digital R&D tools to scientific teams, for example materials informatics, lab data platforms (ELN, LIMS) or simulation software.

  • A track record of sourcing and closing B2B deals with multiple stakeholders and long sales cycles.

  • A network among R&D and business leaders at US industrial companies.

  • The ability to explain AI and computational concepts clearly to scientists and business leaders alike.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the drive to build structure from scratch in a fast-growing startup.

  • Willingness to travel regularly within the US and to Europe.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical)

  • An advanced degree in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering or a related field.

  • Experience at a company working in materials informatics, scientific software or AI for R&D.

  • Experience building a market or commercial function from the ground up.

Location

This role is based in the UK ideally London or Cambridge or Berlin oder Amsterdam, ideally near a major materials, chemicals or semiconductor hub. Expect regular travel to customer sites and to our offices in the UK and Europe (30 - 40 %)

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

Additional Considerations

data.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.


🛠️ About our Driving Product Team

The Driving Product team owns Wayve's core end to end driving model, the algorithm that directly shapes how our vehicles behave on the road. This model already underpins production agreements with Nissan and Mercedes, with further OEM partnerships in the works, so the team's output is tied directly to Wayve's near term commercial milestones. The team is highly iterative: it looks at the top issues we see on the road, root causes them, and drives them out through data, model and evaluation changes, working closely with other teams across the business to resolve issues that span the model and vehicle interface.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Lead the team iterating on L2 driving performance, balancing hands-on technical work with team leadership

  • Diagnose the highest impact issues seen on the road, root cause them, and resolve them through data and model iteration

  • Own changes to data recipes, model architecture, evaluation and release readiness for the driving model

  • Partner with other teams to resolve cross-functional issues, including model and vehicle interface problems

  • Act as one of the team's key hands-on developers, writing code and running experiments alongside directing the team's priorities

🧩 What you'll be working on:

  • The end to end driving model that powers Wayve's L2 product and sits at the centre of our OEM partnerships with Nissan and Mercedes, with further partners in the pipeline

  • Scaling the driving model's performance across different geographies and vehicle platforms while hitting performance and compliance KPIs

  • Data led iteration cycles: using on road and off road evaluation to identify the biggest performance gaps and close them

  • Cross-functional resolution of model and vehicle interface issues, working with specialists across the business

  • Growing and shaping a small, high impact team (initially up to five people) as the driving model programme scales

👤 You should apply if:

  • You're highly technical and hands-on, comfortable writing Python and doing model and data iteration yourself, not just directing others

  • You've delivered deployed, production ML models, ideally in robotics or autonomous vehicles, with experience shipping and iterating on ML for embodied AI applications

  • Alternatively, you've productionised ML models at another company and have experience delivering incremental improvements to a live system over time

  • Your experience is production focused rather than primarily research or early stage exploration

  • You want to keep doing deeply technical work, whether or not you've managed people before. We're looking for strong ICs or tech leads just as much as experienced managers, and are happy to ease the right person into managing a small team

🌱 Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! If you're passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚗 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve's mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

📋 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (20 mins)

  • Competency technical interviews (programming and system design; 2 hours)

  • Deep-dive interviews (domain and technical leadership; 2 hours)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)

We'll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What's in it for you (Location dependent):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partner discounts and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

The role

We’re hiring an operations leader to own collections and customer service for our car finance book, and to build that function into one that can carry 100 times our current volume.

Our operations team is responsible for supporting customers with anything they need: settlements, payment date changes, forbearance arrangements, underwriting, and so much more. Working in a regulated consumer credit space means there are a wide range of regulations and laws that we need to take into account, while also ensuring we put customers first.

We're using tech and AI to build an AI-native operations function, and we're looking for this person to work alongside our engineers to automate everything automatable, while keeping humans involved where human input is required.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll set the strategy and manage the team, but you’ll also take calls, run QA, coach individuals and take the hardest cases yourself.

The role reports into the General Manager, Car Finance

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

We've closed a $20M Series A with Index Ventures and we're deployed in 40+ hospitals across France, with international expansion underway. Our product works, our clients are happy, and the pipeline is growing — but our marketing function doesn't exist yet.

This is our first marketing hire. You'll build the function from scratch and report directly to Paul (our CEO), working closely with Victoire on everything that touches Sales.

Build Parallel's marketing from zero: give us real visibility in the healthcare market, and equip our Sales team with the assets they need to close.

In your first 12 months

You you are :

  • You can produce visuals on your own, without waiting on a designer

  • You know how to prioritize in a fast-moving, still-unstructured environment

You'll be embedded in the Sales team, reporting to Paul. There's no fixed plan to hire someone under you on day one, but managing a freelancer or intern down the line is on the table if it makes sense — to free up your time for higher-impact work, not as a given.

  1. Chat with Wallerand our recruiter - 30'

data.description:
Fuse is an AI-first energy company on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers, we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior or Lead Security Engineer (Detection & Response) to build out the next generation of detection systems.

You'll sit within the team responsible for security across our IT and cloud environment, spanning AWS, identity, endpoints, SaaS and data center infrastructure. You'll own security monitoring and detection end-to-end: anticipating how our systems could be compromised, ensuring we have the right telemetry to see it, and building the detections and response workflows to act on it.

Think of it like SRE for security. We want someone who can answer questions like: Has this account been compromised? Is someone accessing AWS who shouldn't be? Has an attacker moved laterally through our network? How would we know?

You'll also lead investigations and incident response, automate repetitive security work, and work with IT and Engineering to fix the underlying problems you uncover.

Responsibilities

  • Own security monitoring and detection across AWS, identity, endpoints, SaaS, networks and data center environments
  • Build and maintain the telemetry and logging pipelines needed to detect security incidents, and continuously test and improve detection coverage
  • Lead security investigations and incident response from detection through containment, recovery and post-mortem
  • Proactively hunt for threats and identify gaps in our visibility, controls and detection coverage
  • Build automation to improve detection, investigation and response, making effective use of AI and emerging tools to improve efficiency and capabilities.
  • Work closely with IT and Engineering to turn security findings into preventative controls and better system design
  • Develop and test incident response playbooks and continuously improve our response capability
  • Implement and enhance internal AI agents and security bots that assist with monitoring, investigations, reporting, and other security operation tasks.

Requirements

  • Significant hands-on experience in detection engineering, security engineering, incident response, threat hunting or a similar technical role
  • Strong understanding of cloud environments, ideally AWS, and how to monitor them for unauthorised or suspicious activity
  • Strong networking fundamentals and an understanding of how attackers move through networks and systems
  • Strong understanding of attacker tradecraft and the ability to turn it into useful, high-signal detections
  • Experience investigating real security incidents and taking ownership through to resolution
  • Strong scripting or programming skills, ideally Python, and a habit of automating repetitive work
  • Experience with security monitoring and response tooling such as SIEM, EDR, SOAR or equivalent
  • Strong systems thinking and a natural instinct for asking “how would we know if this was compromised?”
  • Comfortable working autonomously and closely with IT and Engineering teams
  • Curious about emerging AI capabilities and proactive in experimenting with AI-assisted development, automation and security workflows.

Strong candidates may also have experience with

  • AWS security telemetry including CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow Logs and IAM
  • Detection-as-code, Sigma, Git-based detections and automated testing
  • CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender or another EDR
  • Network security monitoring, PCAP, NetFlow/sFlow or firewall telemetry
  • Digital forensics, threat intelligence, purple teaming or security validation
  • Data centre or colocation security, including OOB networks and BMC/IPMI
  • Security automation, AI-assisted development or applying AI/LLMs to security engineering and operations.
  • Energy, trading, fintech, critical infrastructure or other high-value-target environments

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
  • Biannual bonus scheme
  • Fully expensed tech to match your needs
  • Private health insurance
  • Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.

LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South.


Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live.


What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth.

As the Senior Growth Manager for the France-Morocco corridor, you'll drive LemFi's expansion within the Moroccan diaspora in one of our most critical markets. While the primary focus of your community-building will be in France, we are open to candidates based in France, the UK, or other European countries where LemFi currently operates.

This is a growth role that requires you to be comfortable traveling to key diaspora hubs to build a physical community presence and drive high-leverage organic growth. You will direct influencer negotiations, manage external agencies and key community leaders, and execute grassroots field marketing.

You'll spend 3 to 5 days every few weeks in a new city (primarily across France or other key European hubs), representing LemFi at events, building partnerships, rigorously tracking campaign performance, and driving user acquisition. You're embedded in the communities we serve, acting as both a strategist and a ground-level operator. You will work across paid channels, organic strategy, and local product teams to drive massive user acquisition in this market, while serving as the voice of the user.

What you'll build and own

  • Travel across France (and potentially other key European markets) 3 to 5 days every few weeks, establishing an on-the-ground presence in key cities. Attend community events, build and expand LemFi's community network with local Moroccan leaders and organizations, and grow relationships that build deep trust.

  • Develop and execute comprehensive user acquisition strategies tailored for the Moroccan diaspora communities in France and Europe. Own growth targets for assigned markets and optimize based on data and insights.

  • Source, negotiate directly with, and manage France/Morocco-focused influencers, community leaders, and external agencies to drive scalable organic growth.

  • Lead community-driven initiatives to build trust, awareness, and advocacy, and participate in local events, meetups, and forums. Build and maintain relationships with community leaders and grassroots partners, implementing tracking mechanisms for the exact customer acquisition cost of your activities.

Your experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in fast-paced environments with a background in growth, sales, marketing or similar.

  • Proven ability to work against targets and deliver measurable results. You're motivated by ambitious goals and comfortable being measured against clear KPIs.

  • Strong data-driven mindset. You interpret data, track performance and adjust strategies accordingly.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with diverse stakeholders. You're a persuasive communicator who can influence partners and leaders.

  • Entrepreneurial and tenacious. You take ownership, push through obstacles and find ways to win. Biased to action, you think critically and move quickly.

  • Self-motivated and effective working independently and in remote environments. You're willing to travel extensively and work occasional weekends to support market growth.

Nice to have

  • Prior experience launching or scaling ventures in new markets.

  • Deep understanding of African and diaspora community in Europe. You're culturally fluent and comfortable immersing yourself in new cultural environments.

  • Background in fintech, payments or diaspora-focused products.

Why Join LemFi?

Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this.

At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions.

data.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Account Executive (mid-market) job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for ‘full-stack’ Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy.

You will interact with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Meet Hakim in this article to learn more about makes the Metallurgy segment so interesting for an Account Executive.

Why is our Vertical approach interesting?

  • Market potential: Vast and dynamic markets with significant structural challenges, offering fertile ground for a modern, tech-driven solution like Alan.

  • Team readiness: We've honed our go-to-market strategy over the years, and it's paying off with increasing inbound leads and active field marketing driving strong pipeline momentum.

  • Passionate teams: Our dedicated teams brings deep sector expertise and genuine passion for the clients we serve; every day in the field sharpens our edge and fuels our conviction.

  • Growth opportunity: The addressable market is enormous, offering virtually unlimited opportunities for growth.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. The average sales cycle is 4-6 months, dealing with companies ranging from 30 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Meet Fanny Cibot who is Account Executive within the Business Services & Media Crew.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Metallurgy Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 4 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.
