data.title: Director, Global Operations Excellence
BDR Talent Programme (Amsterdam)
data.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the Programme

This is a structured 18–24 month global programme designed to launch high-potential commercial careers. You don’t need prior sales or payments experience; what you need is ambition, curiosity, resilience, and the drive to build relationships and solve complex problems.

You will join a global cohort of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with structured learning, dedicated coaching from sales leaders, and real commercial responsibility from month one. Throughout the programme, you will master enterprise sales: researching strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, conducting sharp discovery conversations, and building pipeline that drives real business growth.

High performers transition into Sales, Account Management, and other commercial roles across the business. Many of our top commercial leaders, including our Chief Revenue Officer, started their journey at Checkout.com as BDRs or interns. Whether you are a recent graduate, an early-career professional with 1–3 years of experience, or a career switcher, what matters most is your hunger to learn and achieve.

What You’ll Do

  • Research Strategic Accounts: Identify high-value targets by researching key organizations, industries, and executive stakeholders.

  • Initiate High-Impact Outreach: Open doors with senior decision-makers using personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn.

  • Build Qualified Pipeline: Drive consistent growth momentum through disciplined prospecting, rigorous follow-up, and account mapping.

  • Run Consultative Discovery: Uncover merchants' technical and business challenges to align Checkout.com’s solutions with their goals.

  • Partner on Live Deals: Work alongside Sales Representatives to support opportunities through to deal execution.

  • Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Use CRM, intent data, and approved AI tools to streamline research, refine outreach, and work smarter.

Who We’re Looking For

We welcome applications from recent graduates and professionals with 1–3 years of experience looking to change careers. Regardless of your background, we are looking for the following core skills to set you up for success:

  • Driven & Goal-Oriented: You set high personal standards, work hard, and stay motivated when tackling challenging commercial goals.

  • Resilient & Adaptable: You bounce back quickly from rejection, view obstacles as practice, and maintain consistent output.

  • Relational & Engaging: You genuinely enjoy starting conversations, asking sharp questions, and building trust with diverse stakeholders.

  • Track Record of Achievement: You demonstrate drive and ownership through professional, academic, athletic, or entrepreneurial success.

  • Commercial & Tech Curiosity: You are eager to learn complex fintech products and use AI and sales tools to work smarter.

  • Coachability & Clear Communication: You listen well, articulate ideas clearly, and actively apply feedback to improve performance.

What You’ll Get Out of It

A 2-year structured programme that ensures you have a successful career in sales. A clear progression pathway built around key pillars:

  • Fintech & Enterprise Sales Mastery: Build deep expertise in global payments, digital commerce, and complex deal execution alongside experienced Account Executives.

  • AI-Native Commercial Skills: Master modern sales tools, intent data, and AI to automate routine tasks and focus on high-impact prospecting.

  • Coaching & Leadership Growth: Receive 1:1 mentorship from sales leaders, earn certifications, and take on senior BDR responsibilities, from mentoring peers to working on live deals through pricing and signing

  • Direct Career Acceleration: Graduate with a tight-knit global network and a direct pathway into Account Executive, Account Management, or Commercial Strategy roles.

Want to Stand Out?

When we review your CV, ensure you show us why you're great for this role. Ensure and share something you’ve built, led or achieved, whether that’s hitting a target, launching a side project, or leading a team effort.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

  • Who should apply? Recent graduates, early-career professionals (1–3 years experience), and career changers with strong commercial drive.

  • When does the programme start? We have start dates in March and September 2027.

  • What is the application deadline? Apply early for the best chance of being reviewed. We will close once we receive a sufficient number of applications.

  • Where are the roles located? We have roles in London, New York, Barcelona, Amsterdam, Riyadh, Dubai, and Shanghai.

  • Do I need a second language? Fluent English is required. Specific local language proficiency may be required depending on the hiring region.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

data.title: Senior Director, Analytics & Business Intelligence

The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei, the Canadian fintech company accelerating the business of clients around the world. Nuvei's modular, flexible and scalable technology allows leading companies to accept next-gen payments, offer all payout options and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 50 markets, 150 currencies and 700 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally with one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service.   We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

 

Your Mission 

We are looking for a Senior Director of Analytics & Business Intelligence to join our fast-growing Revenue Operations team. Reporting to our SVP of Global Revenue Operations, you will lead Nuvei’s Commercial reporting and x-functional performance analytics globally, across every segment, channel and vertical. This is a key leadership role responsible for a Commercial analytics suite spanning marketing analytics, revenue acquisition, portfolio and payment performance.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Nuvei’s Commercial reporting and x-functional performance analytics globally, across every segment, channel and vertical
  • Own a Commercial analytics suite spanning marketing analytics, revenue acquisition, portfolio and payment performance

  • Lead root cause analysis of segment, channel, vertical, client and Commercial performance to identify opportunities for revenue optimisation
  • Partner with stakeholders and domain SMEs for detailed diagnostics as needed
  • Standardise and operationalise dashboarding and KPIs across business units and for executive communications
  • Define business requirements and translate into a data, analytics and automation roadmap – migrate from static dashboarding to intelligent decision support
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement to increase speed, clarity and impact of reporting/analytical products

 

Qualifications

  • Player-coach with 15+ years’ experience in delivery of revenue forecasting and profitability analysis, within the payments industry - must
  • Track record of leading and mentoring a team of data analysts and BI developers

Benefits

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process.

data.title: Lead AI Engineer
data.description:
We are AI builders

Since 2018, Enjins has done one thing: ship AI that works in production. From Utrecht and Berlin, we build machine learning systems, data infrastructure, and agentic AI layers for European tech companies, with a deliberate focus on climate and energy, where we believe the biggest technological shift of our generation should meet its most critical challenge.

We embed directly with the engineering teams of high-growth scale-ups like Crisp, PlanBlue, NextSense, and Groendus. We take ownership of the full technical lifecycle: from first architecture decision to a production-grade system running inside our partner's infrastructure, long after go-live.

The role

As Lead AI Engineer, you are the technical owner of client engagements. You architect the solution, ship it to production, and make sure it still performs a year later. Alongside the other Leads, you shape the engineering team and the way we build.

In practice:

  • Design AI roadmaps with client leadership and own them through to production
  • Create and implement the AI solution architectures to deliver on those roadmaps
  • Set and uphold Data Platform and MLOps standards across your client portfolio, so systems stay healthy after handover
  • Mentor engineers and weigh in on hiring, team growth, and accounts
  • Push our engineering practice forward, including how we use agentic coding workflows to build faster without compromising reliability. We test, document, and share what works, so the whole team levels up
  • Elevate our product mindset to ensure we build the right things, not just more things

Why a Lead role here, not somewhere else

You'll work across more stacks, clouds, and frontier frameworks in a year than most engineers see in five, with the collective knowledge of the whole team behind you, not the isolation of freelance work. And because our clients build grid software, energy forecasting, and climate infrastructure, you develop real domain expertise in energy and climate systems on top of production-grade AI engineering.

In your first months you'll join a client project alongside an experienced Enjins engineer, supported by a dedicated coach. Within half a year, you own the technical roadmap of at least one engagement, mentor engineers, and have a recognised voice in our Asset strategy.

Requirements

What matters most: you think in systems, own outcomes end-to-end, and grow the people around you.

  • 5+ years building and scaling data & AI solutions in production environments
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: you write production-grade code and know your way around infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data pipelines)
  • Mastery of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience leading MLOps/LLMOps architectures
  • Proven experience taking LLM-based or agentic systems to production
  • Experience mentoring engineers, overseeing delivery, and managing client accounts
  • You can translate technical complexity into clear decisions for non-technical stakeholders
  • Fluent in English and eligible to work in the Netherlands

Benefits

We publish our salary ranges and keep terms straightforward. No surprises.

Compensation

  • €5,950 - €7,800 gross per month (excl. holiday allowance, pension, bonus, equity, and AI-Leap benefits)
  • Annual performance bonus of 1.5 months' salary
  • Equity participation (VSOP)


Growth

  • AI-Leap: our structured development programme with a dedicated certification budget and a specialised track for Leads
  • 1-on-1 mentoring with our founders and external coaching to close your specific gaps


Team & culture

  • Office on the Oudegracht in Utrecht (note: not yet fully accessible for individuals with physical disabilities); hybrid setup
  • 28 vacation days, flexible across 3 national holidays
  • Monthly team events and the annual two-day Enjins Summer Summit on AI × Climate
  • OV-First travel policy, fully covered; meat-free catering
  • Apple MacBook Pro and the tools you need

data.description:
Functieprofiel

Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software).

Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie.

Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste.


Wat ga jij doen!

In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met:

  • Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3)

  • Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform

  • Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties

  • Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst

  • Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses

  • Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren

  • Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen

  • Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein

Wat wij vragen!

  • Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering:

  • Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering

  • Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC

  • Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT

  • Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI

  • De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen


Wat bieden wij jou!

Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd.

Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities.

Daarnaast:

  • In 2024 is een nieuwe fabriek gerealiseerd

  • Alle processen zijn volledig geautomatiseerd met ProLeiT

  • Volledige data‑integratie ten behoeve van diepgaande procesanalyses

  • Mogelijkheden voor remote support

Geïnteresseerd!

data.title: Product Manager
data.description:
Role summary

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day.

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted.

Responsibilities

  • Product vision, grounded in real user needs

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind.

  • Market scoping and opportunity-spotting

Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog.

  • Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you.

  • The full lifecycle

From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear.

  • The connective tissue across the company 

When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together.

The team you’ll join

You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today.

Life at Bluerock

We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock.


  • 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field  required.

  • A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations, on time and within budget.

  • Genuine ease operating cross-functionally. You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission.

  • An appetite for ambiguity and change: a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem.

  • Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification.

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively.

  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment

Our hiring process

  • Hit the Apply button.

  • Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview

  • A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation.

  • An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS.


Bluerock TMS is an equal opportunities employer. We take pride in our diverse workforce and inclusive workplace. Within a small team of open-minded talents, we ensure an attractive learning environment that you are looking for!

data.title: Senior interim manager in de zorg in loondienst
data.description:
Ben jij een ervaren leider die energie krijgt van het aanbrengen van structuur in uitdagende situaties? Hou je ervan om orde op zaken te stellen en daarna door te gaan naar de volgende interne opdracht? Word jij blij van de afwisseling en uitdaging van een projectmatige rol en met de zekerheid en voordelen van een baan in loondienst? Dan is deze rol als interim manager bij Cordaan iets voor jou! 

Wat ga je doen? 
Als interim manager word je ingezet op locaties van Cordaan waar extra leiderschap en verandering nodig zijn. Dit betekent dat je tijdelijke projectmatige opdrachten uitvoert in de organisatie, waar je snel schakelt, structuur aanbrengt en teams in crisis helpt stabiliseren. Je start elke opdracht met het maken van een projectplan en zorgt dat dit succesvol wordt uitgevoerd. Je zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers optimaal kunnen functioneren en kwalitatieve zorg kunnen bieden. 

Jouw belangrijkste taken: 

  • Leidinggeven in complexe situaties: Je biedt duidelijkheid, hakt knopen door en creëert een veilige en gestructureerde werkomgeving. 

  • Verandermanagement: Je begeleidt afdelingen in transitie en zorgt voor blijvende verbeteringen in zorgkwaliteit en teamdynamiek. 

  • Bedrijfsvoering op orde brengen: Je monitort en rapporteert maandelijks over financiën, medewerkerstevredenheid en verloop. 

  • Samenwerking versterken: Je betrekt vrijwilligers, mantelzorgers en familieleden bij het welzijn van cliënten. 

  • Coachen en inspireren: Je helpt de collega’s op de locatie groeien, zodat zij hun werk met plezier en vertrouwen kunnen doen. 

Wat krijg je van ons? 
Bij Cordaan krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een kleurrijke organisatie die de ambitie heeft de beste zorgverlener en zorgwerkgever van Amsterdam te zijn. Voor deze functie zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden conform cao VVT: 

  • Een jaarcontract (32 - 36 uur per week) met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband; 

  • Salaris conform CAO VVT FWG 60: min. € 4.157 en max. € 6.171 bruto (o.b.v. 36 uur per week); 

  • Extra’s: Eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%) en vakantiegeld (8%); 

  • Reiskosten: een vergoeding á € 0,21 per km en een fietsplan; 

  • Pensioenopbouw via Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn;   

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden: Volop mogelijkheden om je persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen;  

  • Collega aandragen? Ontvang in totaal een aanbrengbonus van € 500,- netto.


Wie ben jij? 
Jij bent een manager met een sterke persoonlijkheid en ruime ervaring in crisis- en verandermanagement in de zorg. Je kan projectmatig werken en weet hoe je teams motiveert en veranderingen succesvol implementeert. 

Verder heb je: 

  • Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring als leidinggevende; 

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in zorgmanagement, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting én een aanvullende cursus of opleiding gevolgd op het gebied van verander- en/of crisismanagement; 

  • Ervaring met begeleiding van meerdere verander- of crisismanagement trajecten in de zorg; 

  • Aantoonbare beheersing van minimaal 3 van de volgende competenties (blijkend uit recente talentenscan of 360⁰ feedback): resultaatgerichtheid, visie, verandermanagement en beïnvloedingskracht. 

Waar ga je werken? 
Als interim manager kun je ingezet worden binnen een van de verschillende zorgdomeinen van Cordaan in Amsterdam in de ouderenzorg, Jeugd, GGZ en gehandicaptenzorg. Je wordt flexibel ingezet op locaties waar tijdelijke versterking nodig is, zodat jij impact kunt maken waar het écht telt. 

Enthousiast?

data.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
data.description:
As Optics11 continues to grow, we are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer – Hardware Design to take ownership of the mechanical hardware development of high-performance fiber-optic measurement systems used in demanding energy and marine environments.

At Optics11, we develop cutting-edge fiber-optic sensing solutions that make critical infrastructure and underwater security systems smarter, safer, and more reliable.

In this role, you will design ruggedized chassis, enclosures, and mechanical assemblies that protect and integrate electronic, photonic, fiber-optic, and electromechanical subsystems. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams and external partners to develop robust, manufacturable, and serviceable hardware solutions that support integration, qualification, manufacturing, and long-term operation.

You will apply structured engineering methods, sound technical judgement, and rigorous verification practices to ensure products perform reliably under vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, and other environmental conditions.

What you'll do:

  • Lead the mechanical design and development of chassis, enclosures, mounting structures, and assemblies for fiber-optic measurement systems, from concept through qualification and release.

  • Collaborate with electronics, photonics, optical, and systems engineering teams to define PCB placement, optical component integration, fiber routing, interconnections, thermal interfaces, and packaging constraints.

  • Design robust hardware solutions that meet vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, environmental, serviceability, and lifecycle requirements for energy and marine applications.

  • Develop modular, maintainable, and upgradeable hardware architectures that support manufacturability, serviceability, and long-term product support.

  • Create and maintain engineering documentation, including drawings, specifications, design calculations, assembly instructions, and manufacturing documentation.

  • Manage technical collaboration with suppliers, manufacturers, OEMs, and external development partners to ensure performance, quality, manufacturability, and qualification requirements are met.

  • Support prototype development, subsystem integration, environmental and mechanical testing, product qualification, and release activities.

  • Analyze test results, performance margins, failure modes, and operational limits to improve product robustness, reliability, and design maturity.

  • Apply engineering analyses, trade-off studies, DfMA principles, simulation tools, and FEA to optimize mechanical, thermal, structural, dynamic, manufacturability, lifecycle, and cost performance.

  • Investigate qualification failures, manufacturing issues, integration challenges, and field performance topics using structured problem-solving and root cause analysis.

  • Provide technical input during design reviews, engineering discussions, development decisions, and cross-functional integration activities.

  • Plan and execute work in line with priorities, milestones, quality expectations, and timelines, while proactively communicating risks, dependencies, and recommendations.

  • Share expertise, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability, collaboration, product quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided3 times/ week.


Qualifications:

  • MSc in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline with a focus on mechanical design of opto-electronic, electronic, photonic, or other high-tech hardware products.

  • 5+ years of experience in multidisciplinary product development environments.

  • Strong experience designing chassis, enclosures, hardware packaging solutions, and mechanical assemblies for high-performance products.

  • Proven track record in developing ruggedized opto-electronic hardware products from concept through qualification and release.

  • Strong understanding of vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, and environmental requirements for demanding operational environments.

  • Experience with 3D CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, NX, or similar.

  • Experience creating engineering drawings, specifications, and manufacturing documentation.

  • Strong analytical mindset with experience in structured problem solving and engineering verification.

  • Strong communication skills in English and collaborative working style.

  • Eligible for EU/NATO security clearance.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with fiber-optic integration, optical component packaging, or photonic hardware development.

  • Experience with CE/FCC, MIL, NATO, and/or STANAG qualification standards.

  • Experience with ruggedized chassis standards used in defense, marine, aerospace, or industrial applications (e.g. VPX, CompactPCI, uTCA).

  • Experience managing external suppliers, manufacturers, and development partners.

  • Experience supporting environmental qualification, certification, or product compliance programs.

Please note that we can only consider candidates who are currently residing in the Netherlands and already have the legal right to work here without requiring visa sponsorship or a work permit.

data.title: Social Media & Project Coordination (m/f/d), Fashion Week Focus
data.description:
About us
Fashion Revolution Germany e.V. is the German chapter of Fashion Revolution, the global movement for a clean, safe, fair, transparent and accountable fashion industry. Since the Rana Plaza factory collapse in 2013, the movement has asked one question: Who made my clothes? As a non-profit association of designers, educators, communicators and activists, we run campaigns, workshops and events that make fashion’s social and environmental impacts visible and show practical alternatives such as repair, upcycling and circular models.

The project: RE/CLAIMED at Berlin Fashion Week
A key focus of this internship is RE/CLAIMED, a multidisciplinary sustainable fashion show supported by Fashion Revolution Germany. RE/CLAIMED combines upcycled runway looks, dance, live performance, music and interactive installations to change how people value their clothes. After a sold-out first edition in January 2026, the second edition will take place with around 400 guests expected.

Your role
You’ll pilot the day-to-day social media activities for RE/CLAIMED in the run-up to Berlin Fashion Week, during the show and in the follow-up. You’ll also support the coordination of the show and of Fashion Revolution Germany’s projects in Berlin. You’ll work directly with Eric Vincent Vinsonneau, who leads RE/CLAIMED, and alongside our communications partners.

Beyond RE/CLAIMED, you’ll take part in other Fashion Revolution Germany activities in Berlin. One example is our stand at the Alt-Rixdorfer Christmas Market in Neukölln on the weekend of 4–6 December 2026, where you’ll help with preparation, on-site support and social media coverage.

Your tasks

Social media (main focus)

  • Plan and manage the content calendar for RE/CLAIMED’s Instagram, and optionally build a TikTok presence

  • Create posts, stories and reels: behind the scenes, designer and performer portraits, countdowns and impact facts

  • Cover the show live and produce recap content afterwards

  • Engage with the community, partners, designers and press, and track performance

Project coordination

  • Support show preparation: partners, designers, models, dancers, volunteers and schedules

  • Help with on-site logistics on the show day

  • Support other Fashion Revolution Germany projects in Berlin as needed

Your profile

  • You have a strong interest in sustainable fashion and social or environmental topics

  • You have experience creating social media content, ideally including short-form video

  • You have a good eye for aesthetics and storytelling

  • You’re organised, reliable and proactive, and comfortable working independently in a small team

  • You speak fluent English (our working language). German is a strong plus.

  • Bonus: Canva, CapCut, Adobe or similar tools; experience with events, fashion or non-profits

What we offer

  • Real responsibility for the social media of a show at Berlin Fashion Week

  • Hands-on insight into producing a fashion show, from planning to the runway

  • Access to a strong network in Berlin’s sustainable fashion, creative and NGO scene

  • Room for your own ideas and formats

  • Hybrid and flexible working arrangements

  • An internship certificate, and supervision and documentation for mandatory internships

Details

  • Period: December 2026 – February 2027 (3 months)

  • Hours: part-time or full-time, depending on your availability and study requirements

  • Location: Berlin, hybrid (to be discussed). Presence is required on the show day and for key preparation dates.

  • Type: unpaid internship, ideal as a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum) as part of your studies

  • Working language: English

How to apply
Send us your CV in English by 30 Oktober 2026. Links to social media content you’ve created are very welcome.

Contact: Eric Vincent Vinsonneau

E-Mail: -----

data.title: Marketplace Manager (m/w/d)
data.description:
Über Neolymp

NEOLYMP ist eine Fitnessmarke aus Berlin, die 2018 gegründet wurde und hochwertige Fitnessprodukte entwickelt – von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking-Pads. Im DACH-Raum sind wir auf den großen Marktplätzen stark vertreten: Amazon ist unser wichtigster Kanal, dazu kommen Otto, Decathlon und unser eigener Onlineshop.

Unser Ziel ist klar: 100 % Wachstum pro Jahr bei starker Profitabilität. In den nächsten drei Jahren wollen wir auf 100 Mio. € Umsatz wachsen, und das Marketplace-Team wächst mit.

Du verantwortest den Erfolg unserer Produkte auf Amazon, Otto und Decathlon im Tagesgeschäft. Du berichtest an unseren Head of Marketplaces und arbeitest eng mit Content, Design und Logistik zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst das Tagesgeschäft auf Amazon (Seller Central), Otto und Decathlon: Sortiment, Preise, Bestände, Buy Box und Account Health.
  • Du planst und optimierst Werbekampagnen (Sponsored Products, Brands, Display) mit klarem Blick auf ACoS, TACoS und Profitabilität.
  • Du recherchierst Keywords, wertest Wettbewerber aus und gibst dem Listing- und Content-Team klare Briefings, was auf welchem Listing verbessert werden soll.
  • Du analysierst Umsatz, Marge und Rankings, erkennst Chancen früh und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
  • Du stimmst Bestandsplanung und Nachschub mit unserer Logistik ab, damit Bestseller lieferfähig bleiben.
  • Du baust neue Marktplätze und Länder mit auf, von der Anbindung bis zum laufenden Betrieb.

Dein Profil

  • 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Marketplace Management, davon nachweislich auf Amazon (Seller Central).
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Amazon Advertising und den gängigen Kennzahlen.
  • Du kennst Otto und Decathlon als Marktplätze, idealerweise hast du bereits mit ihnen gearbeitet.
  • Analytisches Denken und sicherer Umgang mit Excel bzw. Google Sheets; Tools wie Helium 10, Sellerboard kennst du oder lernst sie schnell.
  • Erfahrung aus einem E-Commerce-Startup oder einer wachsenden Marke ist ein Plus.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und kommunizierst klar, auch remote.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Wachstum zum Mitgestalten: Du arbeitest an einer Marke auf dem Weg zu 100 Mio. € und siehst die Wirkung deiner Arbeit direkt im Umsatz.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest vollständig remote und gestaltest dein Arbeiten eigenverantwortlich.
  • Zusatzleistungen: moderne Hardware, Zugang zu Corporate Benefits, eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug und ein persönliches Educational Budget.
  • Startup-Umfeld: kurze Entscheidungswege und regelmäßige Team-Events in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.

Wenn wir damit dein Interesse geweckt haben, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Wir sind gespannt darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

data.title: Talent Acquisition Werkstudent (m/f/d)
data.description:
Über Buena

Buena (finanziert von Google Ventures) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen oder Finanzieren einer Wohnung. Wir übernehmen deutschlandweit Hausverwaltungen und verwandeln diese in Technologieunternehmen. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern in Berlin zur zweitgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands mit mehr als 400 Mitarbeitern geworden.

Über die Rolle

Wir suchen einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) für unser Talent Acquisition Team, um unseren Wettbewerbsvorteil im M&A-Bereich weiter auszubauen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese Talente für uns zu gewinnen.

Aufgaben

Recruiting ist ein zentraler Teil unserer Unternehmensstrategie, daher erwarten wir eine stark technologie-unterstützte Arbeitsweise, Outputorientierung und Professionalität im Umgang mit den Talenten.

  • 80% deiner ersten Monate verbringst du im Sourcing von Talenten via unserer verschiedener Kanäle. Du übernimmst auch erste Screening Gespräche.

  • Du screenst den deutschen Markt systematisch und baust strategische Talentpools für zukünftige Targets auf.

  • Du bringst dich mit Gestaltungsideen zu unserem Kanal-Mix zur Anziehung von Talenten in unsere TA Strategie aktiv mit ein.

Qualifikation

  • Vor Ort in unserem HQ in Berlin (Prenzlauer Berg) arbeiten willst.

  • Dich auf mindestens 12 Monate Werkstudententätigkeit committen kannst.

  • Ein nachweislich ausgeprägtes Interesse an Menschen und Unternehmertum mitbringst.

  • Eine hohe Resilienz in der Direktansprache besitzt, souverän agierst und ergebnisorientiert arbeitest.

  • Eine sehr steile Lernkurve in den Bereichen Methodik und Technologie-unterstützten Arbeiten möchtest.

Benefits

  • Schnelle Aufstiegschancen in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Startups Europas.

  • MacBook & Studio Display.

  • Attraktives Gehalt, inklusive 500 € „Close-to-Office"-Bonus.

  • 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.

  • Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen willst.

  • Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro.

Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen, ziehen Menschen an, die etwas bewegen wollen. Bei der fino data services arbeitest du mit Menschen, die neugierig sind, schnell denken und Dinge gerne selbst in die Hand nehmen. Du bekommst dabei nicht nur ein Team, sondern Rückenwind für deine Ideen, Raum zum Ausprobieren und Menschen, die mit dir aus einer guten Idee etwas besonderes machen. Wenn du Lust hast, mit Leuten zu arbeiten, die genauso viel vorhaben wie du: Willkommen bei der fino data services.

Die Rolle:
Die E-Rechnung wird Pflicht – und wir wollen die Adresse sein, an die Kunden, Kanzleien und Partner dabei zuerst denken. Mit InvoiceRails betreiben wir einen zertifizierten Peppol Access Point, mit GetMyInvoices eine Plattform für über 14.000 Kunden und mit Belegbote ein kostenloses E-Rechnungs-Postfach. Als Product Expert E-Invoicing bist du die Stimme der fino data services zur E-Rechnung: Du vertrittst das Thema im Markt und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Produkte und Services der gesetzlichen Pflicht immer einen Schritt voraus sind.

Aufgaben

Nach außen

  • Du hältst Webinare für Kunden, Steuerkanzleien und Partner.

  • Du sprichst auf Konferenzen und Fachveranstaltungen wie dem E-Rechnungs-Gipfel.

  • Du vertrittst uns in Arbeitskreisen, z. B. im Verband elektronische Rechnung (VeR) und bei OpenPeppol.

  • Du lieferst Fachinhalte, mit denen unser Marketing in den Markt geht.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Kunden, Kanzleien und Partner uns als Adresse für die E-Rechnung wahrnehmen – und dass daraus Anfragen entstehen.

Produkte und Services

  • Du hältst InvoiceRails, GetMyInvoices, Belegbote und Services wie den Billing Manager gesetzlich aktuell.

data.title: Senior Post Producer (m/w/d)
Senior Strategic Finance Manager
data.description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

 

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager Strategic Finance to help lead DuckDuckGo's FP&A processes and strategic finance initiatives. You'll partner with cross-functional leadership on key decisions and evaluate the scale and profitability of new products, M&A and other strategic investments.

 

You'll build financial models for scenarios such as product expansion, search monetization, marketing ROI, and potential acquisitions. You'll review and summarize financial results and play a key role in quarterly forecasts (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and annual and long-term planning. You'll also own recurring deliverables, including forecast variance, user metrics, P&L and headcount analyses. You'll help scale the team's processes, using AI tools like Claude and BI tools like Tableau and Grafana to make workflows more efficient.

 

We're a collaborative, transparent, self-motivated team. If our core values (build trust, question assumptions, and validate direction) resonate with you, you'll fit right in!

 

About You

  • 8+ years in strategic finance (FP&A, corporate development, investment banking, or consulting).

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling, including three-statement forecasts.

  • Track record of owning complex, ambiguous analysis end to end and tying it to clear metrics.

  • Experience building working relationships with business partners and collaborating toward company objectives.

  • An instinct for automating recurring analysis, including with AI tools.

  • Clear, concise writing for senior leadership in a remote, async environment.

  • Dashboard experience: Tableau, Grafana, and Sage Intacct are a plus.

  • Sales finance, GTM, corporate finance, or M&A a plus.

  • U.S. GAAP accounting and reporting knowledge.

  • North America based.

  • Ad-based/subscription, technology, or public company experience a plus.

Compensation

$190,500 to $214,767 USD / $253,500 to $284,417 CAD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

 

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

 

Please note that:

  • You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

 

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

 

Key Principles:

  • Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

  • Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

  • Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at

data.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

  • Internally developed moderation technologies. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. data.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are looking for a customer-oriented and results-driven candidate to join our Account Management Team. As a Senior Account Manager DACH at Perk, you will be actively contributing to our continued customer satisfaction as well as working to increase growth and margin within existing accounts.

Following our recent acquisition and rebranding, your role now encompasses our fully integrated Travel and Spend ecosystem. You will be responsible for a portfolio of large SMB accounts within the DACH market, helping them streamline not just their travel, but their entire expense management workflow. You must possess a genuine hunger to navigate your accounts in a fast-changing, hyper-growth environment, be ready to roll up your sleeves, and work hard.

What You Will Do:

  • Portfolio Management: Own a portfolio of large SMB customers and develop a high level of customer engagement with influential users (Admins, Finance Directors, Travel Managers) within those accounts.

  • Strategic Consultation: Gain a deep understanding of your customers' business and show you understand and identify with their goals as an organization. You will consult them on consolidating their financial stack by leveraging Perk’s unified Travel and Spend capabilities, identifying opportunities to optimize their expense reconciliation and cost control.

  • Product Expertise: Develop a deep understanding of the Perk portfolio of products—including our core Travel platform and our new Spend management solution. You will use this knowledge to guide customers through the benefits of an all-in-one T&E solution.

  • Expansion & Growth: Actively identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities for the Spend product within your existing book of business, driving adoption of corporate cards, automated invoice processing, and expense management features.

  • Problem Solving: Identify common problems within each account—whether related to bookings or expense workflows—and develop strategies to solve each issue in a timely manner whilst also developing foolproof methods to ensure repeat issues are a thing of the past.

  • Advocacy: Be Perk’s biggest advocate within your clients and your clients' biggest advocate within Perk. You’ll be the first one to address any issues, get support from our technical teams, and educate your clients on new product features across both Travel and Spend modules.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience within an Account Management or Customer Success role, preferably managing a portfolio of B2B clients.

  • Native or near-native proficiency in German.

  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

  • Experience in the Travel industry, Fintech, Expense Management, or SaaS products is highly desirable.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to explain complex integrations between travel bookings and financial reporting.

  • Customer-focused with a passion for working with people and solving financial pain points for businesses.

  • Excellent analytical abilities with fluency in Excel and data interpretation.

  • Solid analytical background to help clients visualise their T&E ROI.


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are:

  • A Trusted Collaborator: You care about collective team wins, foster transparent working relationships, and bring a straightforward, low-politics mindset to work.

  • Results-Driven: You know how to filter out noise and stay locked onto core objectives, taking full ownership of major milestones like key-account rollouts.

  • Feedback-Oriented: You view constructive feedback as a tool for growth, seeking input early, iterating fast, and sharing honest perspectives with your team.

  • A Strategic Client Partner: You naturally empathize with the financial and operational challenges our clients face, using those insights to build lasting, high-trust partnerships.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

 

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 45mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

#LI-Hybrid

Following our recent acquisition and rebranding, your role now encompasses our fully integrated Travel and Spend ecosystem. You will be responsible for a portfolio of large SMB accounts within the DACH market, helping them streamline not just their travel, but their entire expense management workflow. You must possess a genuine hunger to navigate your accounts in a fast-changing, hyper-growth environment, be ready to roll up your sleeves, and work hard.

What You Will Do:

  • Portfolio Management: Own a portfolio of large SMB customers and develop a high level of customer engagement with influential users (Admins, Finance Directors, Travel Managers) within those accounts.

  • Strategic Consultation: Gain a deep understanding of your customers' business and show you understand and identify with their goals as an organization. You will consult them on consolidating their financial stack by leveraging Perk’s unified Travel and Spend capabilities, identifying opportunities to optimize their expense reconciliation and cost control.

  • Product Expertise: Develop a deep understanding of the Perk portfolio of products—including our core Travel platform and our new Spend management solution. You will use this knowledge to guide customers through the benefits of an all-in-one T&E solution.

  • Expansion & Growth: Actively identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities for the Spend product within your existing book of business, driving adoption of corporate cards, automated invoice processing, and expense management features.

  • Problem Solving: Identify common problems within each account—whether related to bookings or expense workflows—and develop strategies to solve each issue in a timely manner whilst also developing foolproof methods to ensure repeat issues are a thing of the past.

  • Advocacy: Be Perk’s biggest advocate within your clients and your clients' biggest advocate within Perk. You’ll be the first one to address any issues, get support from our technical teams, and educate your clients on new product features across both Travel and Spend modules.

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience within an Account Management or Customer Success role, preferably managing a portfolio of B2B clients.

  • Native or near-native proficiency in German.

  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

  • Experience in the Travel industry, Fintech, Expense Management, or SaaS products is highly desirable.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to explain complex integrations between travel bookings and financial reporting.

  • Customer-focused with a passion for working with people and solving financial pain points for businesses.

  • Excellent analytical abilities with fluency in Excel and data interpretation.

  • Solid analytical background to help clients visualise their T&E ROI.


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are:

  • A Trusted Collaborator: You care about collective team wins, foster transparent working relationships, and bring a straightforward, low-politics mindset to work.

  • Results-Driven: You know how to filter out noise and stay locked onto core objectives, taking full ownership of major milestones like key-account rollouts.

  • Feedback-Oriented: You view constructive feedback as a tool for growth, seeking input early, iterating fast, and sharing honest perspectives with your team.

  • A Strategic Client Partner: You naturally empathize with the financial and operational challenges our clients face, using those insights to build lasting, high-trust partnerships.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

AI at Perk

We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

data.title: Staff Backend Engineer
data.description:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.

That takes high standards, high velocity and engineers who own what they ship.

Today, we serve over 6 million clients, with more than €38 billion in assets under management. At that scale, performance, reliability and data integrity are part of the product.

Our platform is powered by a modern, high-performance engineering stack designed for scale and reliability: Java 21 (Spring), Go, Node.js (TypeScript), PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Redis, Kafka, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, Docker, Grafana, AWS, Kubernetes and Kibana.

About the role

Staff Backend Engineers shape technical direction across teams while remaining close to the systems and code. You will take on problems whose consequences extend beyond one service or delivery cycle.

This is not a people-management role. Its leverage comes from technical judgement, credible execution and the ability to help other engineers make better decisions.

What you’ll do

  • Own high-consequence backend problems that span services, teams or product domains.

  • Establish clear system boundaries and architectural direction without creating unnecessary central control.

  • Lead technical decisions by making constraints, alternatives, risks and trade-offs explicit.

  • Improve performance, resilience, data integrity, operability and failure handling across production systems.

  • Resolve recurring structural problems rather than treating symptoms team by team.

  • Remain hands-on where implementation, diagnosis or prototyping is the fastest way to create clarity.

  • Mentor senior engineers, raise review quality and make strong engineering judgement easier to reproduce across teams.

  • Partner with engineering and product leaders on sequencing, risk and long-term technical investment.

What you need to have

  • Evidence of technical impact across multiple teams or a substantial product domain.

  • Deep ownership of distributed backend systems operating at meaningful scale.

  • Strong judgement in service boundaries, asynchronous communication, data ownership, consistency and failure modes.

  • Deep knowledge of relational databases, transactions, concurrency and high-performance design.

  • A track record of improving reliability, scalability, observability or developer effectiveness through durable mechanisms.

  • The ability to influence technical direction through evidence, clarity and trusted execution rather than title.

  • Clear communication that helps teams act on complex technical decisions.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals and the judgement to choose when to standardise, simplify or leave a system alone.

Staff scope is assessed through ownership, judgement and sustained organisational impact—not years of experience or familiarity with every technology listed.

What to expect

  • Recruiter conversation

  • Code Review

  • System Design

  • Managerial interview

Your recruiter will explain each stage clearly and follow up after every conversation.

data.title: Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) Voll- oder Teilzeit, Böblingen (hybrid)
data.description:
WORUM ES GEHT

Du übernimmst die Finanzbuchhaltung von Thorit, hands-on und eigenständig. Zusammen mit unserem CFO bist du das Finance-Team: Du buchst selbst, hältst die Zahlen sauber und gestaltest mit, wie unsere Finanzprozesse künftig aussehen.

Wir sind eine AI-Beratung. Was wir bei unseren Kunden automatisieren, wollen wir auch intern umsetzen, und die Finanzbuchhaltung bietet sich dafür besonders an. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der sauber bucht und gleichzeitig Lust hat, Abläufe neu zu denken.

Heute liegt ein großer Teil der laufenden Buchhaltung noch bei unserer Steuerkanzlei. Langfristig wollen wir deutlich mehr davon selbst machen. In welchem Tempo und in welcher Reihenfolge, entscheidest du mit.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Du buchst eigenständig in DATEV: Kreditoren, Debitoren, Sachkonten und Bankabstimmung

  • Du räumst Altbestände auf und hältst die offenen Posten aktuell

  • Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss vor und machst daraus einen dokumentierten, wiederholbaren Prozess

  • Du sorgst für korrekte und fristgerechte Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen

  • Du rechnest Reisekosten ab

  • Du bist Ansprechperson für unsere Steuerkanzlei und begleitest den Jahresabschluss

  • Du schaust dir unsere Abläufe kritisch an und automatisierst, was sinnvoll ist, zum Beispiel Belegzuordnung, Abstimmungen oder Auswertungen

  • Du übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Aufgaben, die heute noch extern laufen

  • Du dokumentierst unsere Finance-Prozesse in Confluence

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

Notwendig

  • Mehrjährige Praxis in der deutschen Finanzbuchhaltung, sodass du im Tagesgeschäft ohne lange Einarbeitung loslegen kannst

  • Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV

  • Solides Wissen im Handels- und Steuerrecht, soweit es die Buchhaltung betrifft

  • Du arbeitest gern eigenständig und triffst Entscheidungen, auch wenn niemand danebensteht

  • Du bist neugierig und eignest dir neue Themen schnell selbst an

  • Du interessierst dich für Digitalisierung und AI und willst dich darin weiterentwickeln. Programmierkenntnisse brauchst du nicht.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch für den Arbeitsalltag (unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch, ein Teil des Teams sitzt in Lissabon)

  • Du wohnst im Raum Böblingen und bist regelmäßig im Büro

Schön zu haben

  • Erste Erfahrung mit Automatisierung in der Buchhaltung, etwa Bankregeln, Belegmatching, Schnittstellen oder AI-Tools

  • Erfahrung mit DATEV Lohn und Gehalt (die Abrechnung läuft aktuell extern, ist aber perspektivisch ein Thema)

  • Erfahrung mit Jahresabschlüssen zusammen mit einer externen Kanzlei

  • Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (abgeschlossen oder geplant)

UNSER SETUP

  • WeClapp als führendes System für Rechnungsausgang, Eingangsrechnungen und offene Posten

  • DATEV für die Buchhaltung und den Austausch mit der Kanzlei

  • Qonto für Kontoanbindung und Belegmatching mit DATEV-Schnittstelle

  • TravelPerk für Reisebuchungen

  • Confluence für Dokumentation, Forecast für Zeiterfassung, HubSpot als CRM

  • Claude ist bei uns Standardwerkzeug. Es ersetzt keine Buchhaltung, nimmt dir aber Recherche, Dokumentation und wiederkehrende Fleißarbeit ab.

WAS WIR DIR ZUSAGEN

  • Alle Zugriffe ab Tag 1: Bankvollmachten, System- und Leserechte

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CFO und kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung

  • Echten Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust Finance mit auf, statt ein fertiges System zu verwalten

  • Zeit, um Automatisierungen auszuprobieren und dich in AI weiterzubilden

RAHMENBEDINGUNGEN

  • Standort: Böblingen, mindestens 2 Bürotage pro Woche

  • Umfang: Vollzeit oder Teilzeit ab 25 Std./Woche

  • Start: ab sofort

Was wir bieten

  • Vorsorge & Zuschüsse: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge über die Allianz mit gestaffeltem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 50 bis 290 € monatlich, dazu Lunchit-Essenszuschuss von bis zu 100 € monatlich

  • Flexibilität: Bis zu 4 Wochen pro Jahr Arbeiten von überall in der EU inklusive 500 € Zuschuss, Spaces-Coworking-Mitgliedschaft, flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Gesundheit & Mobilität: Business Bike Leasing, Urban Sports Club mit Zugang zu über 8.000 Standorten

  • Weiterbildung: Vollzugriff auf die Blinkist-Business-Bibliothek (4.500+ Titel), 3 Monate Babbel, vollständig finanzierte HubSpot-Zertifizierungen

  • Kultur: Flache Hierarchien mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung, moderner Toolstack, Corporate Benefits bei über 800 Marken

Über Thorit

Thorit ist die AI- und CRM-Beratung für das agentische Unternehmen. Als Diamond HubSpot Partner arbeiten wir mit B2B-Kunden im DACH-Markt: Wir bauen die Agenten-Ebene auf HubSpot und den umliegenden Systemen auf – und betreiben sie gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden. Was wir dort empfehlen, wenden wir auch intern an: weniger Handarbeit, mehr Struktur. Diese Rolle ist ein zentraler Teil davon.

Wenn du magst, schreib uns ein paar Sätze dazu, wie du schon einmal eine unaufgeräumte Buchhaltung in Ordnung gebracht hast. Das interessiert uns mehr als jede Formulierung im Anschreiben – wir fragen sonst im Gespräch danach.

data.title: Graphene Photonics Data Analyst (f/m/d)
data.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Graphene Photonics Data Analyst, you will transform complex characterization data into reliable insights that guide device design, process development, and manufacturing decisions. You will own and evolve our analysis software, develop new methods for emerging experiments, and help scale our analytical capabilities as we transition from R&D to high-volume production.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Own and continuously improve our characterization analysis software suite

  • Develop new analysis methods as experiments and measurement capabilities evolve

  • Handle large measurement datasets spanning electrical, optical, and electro-optical characterization

  • Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of analysis outputs

  • Turn raw measurement data into actionable insights for process and design decisions

  • Extract device parameters from measured data and benchmark results against physical and compact models

  • Perform statistical process and yield analyses to identify trends, correlations, and outliers across wafers and lots

  • Correlate characterization results with process parameters, closing the loop between measurement and process control

  • Integrate analysis outputs with fab MES and data systems to enable real-time process feedback

  • Define standardized analysis protocols and transition mature R&D code into robust, production-ready tools

  • Optimize analysis pipelines for throughput and scalability as we move toward high-volume production

Your Qualifications

  • An M.S. or PhD in Data Science, Physics, or another relevant technical discipline

  • At least two years of relevant industry or research experience; a related PhD project

  • Strong Python skills and a genuine passion for building high-quality software

  • A proven track record of designing, developing, and owning a software pipeline or technical project end-to-end

  • A solid foundation in device physics, including solid-state physics, semiconductor devices, and photonics

  • Experience with statistical analysis, model fitting, and parameter extraction

  • Experience with data visualization and tracking trends across wafers, lots, or manufacturing processes

  • The ability to work with laboratory or fab instrument interfaces

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry
