data.title: Research Engineer, GPU Performance
data.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

As a Research Engineer, GPU performance, you will sit at the heart of that spectrum: your low-level work directly determines how fast our frontier models can be trained and served. Working hand-in-hand with Research Scientists, you'll make every GPU count.

Mistral AI is hiring an expert in pushing large language model's GPU utilization and performance to their limits.. In this role, you will own the performance of our models end-to-end: writing the low-level code that extracts the maximum capacity from high-end hardware, and rethinking model architectures so they run efficiently at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Develop low-level code that takes full advantage of high-end GPUs and maxes out their capacity — from custom kernels to memory-layout and communication optimisations.

  • Rethink parts of the generative model architecture to make them more suitable for efficient inference, in collaboration with Research Scientists.

  • Integrate low-level efficient code into a high-level MLOps framework, so that optimisations benefit every training run and deployment rather than a single experiment.

  • Profile, benchmark and squeeze performance out of large-scale training and inference on thousands of GPUs.

  • Model LLM execution on various GPUs with high fidelity to assess hardware usage and build serving performance estimates.

What We're Looking For

  • High technical competence for writing custom low-level kernels and pushing GPUs to their limits.

  • High expertise in the distributed computation infrastructure of current-generation GPU clusters.

  • Overall understanding of the field of generative AI; knowledge of, or interest in, fine-tuning and using language models for applications.

  • Strong software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD.

  • Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative.

What We Offer

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

data.title: Dessinateur Projeteur CAO
data.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Au sein de l'équipe technique, vous concevez en CAO les pièces et sous-ensembles mécaniques de nos produits, dans nos drones et leurs équipements embarqués. Votre quotidien est la modélisation sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks : mécanismes et pièces imprimés en 3D, intégration des composants électroniques, assemblages complets.

Vous faites évoluer rapidement les designs à partir des impressions et des essais, et vous produisez les plans, nomenclatures et documents de montage des versions validées.

Missions principales

Conception CAO (cœur de métier : 70 %)

  • Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks des pièces et sous-ensembles : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces

  • Concevoir des mécanismes imprimés en 3D : charnières, verrouillages, clips, pièces mobiles

  • Intégrer les composants électroniques dans la CAO : implantation des cartes, moteurs, ESC, batteries et capteurs, passage des câbles, refroidissement, accessibilité pour la maintenance

  • Appliquer les règles de conception FDM et autres procédés : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports

  • Structurer les assemblages (paramétrage, composants réutilisables) pour faciliter les évolutions

  • Assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO

  • Réaliser des conceptions paramétriques et modifiables

Prototypage rapide (15 %)

  • Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D → test → correction

  • Préparer les impressions sous OrcaSlicer et assembler les prototypes

  • Faire évoluer les designs à partir des retours d'impression et d'essais

Plans et documentation de production (10 %)

  • Réaliser les mises en plan et les nomenclatures des pièces et sous-ensembles validés

  • Participer à la rédaction des gammes de montage et des instructions d'assemblage

  • Participer aux modifications des schémas de câblage

Essais (5 %)

  • Participer aux essais de validation : banc, sol et, le cas échéant, essais en vol encadrés

  • Présenter régulièrement l'avancement à l'équipe technique

Profil recherché

Formation et expérience

  • Bac+2/+3 (BTS CPRP ou CPI, BUT GMP, licence pro) en conception mécanique, génie mécanique ou mécatronique

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO 3D, idéalement Autodesk Fusion et SolidWorks (CATIA ou d'autres)

  • Conception de mécanismes et d'assemblages

  • Règles de conception pour l'impression 3D FDM ; pratique d'OrcaSlicer ou d'un autre slicer

  • Mise en plan, cotation et tolérancement

  • Bases en électronique embarquée : lecture de schémas, câblage, soudure

Atouts

  • Connaissance du monde des drones (multirotors, voilure fixe, ArduPilot / PX4)

  • Notions d'aérodynamique (portance, traînée, profils, hélices)

  • Projets personnels ou associatifs en drone, robotique ou impression 3D (portfolio CAO apprécié)

  • Intérêt pour l'aéronautique, le spatial ou la défense

Qualités personnelles

  • Goût pour le prototypage et le travail « hands-on » et la CAO "bien faite"

  • Rigueur et sens du détail, indispensables dans un contexte défense où la fiabilité des pièces est critique

  • Autonomie, force de proposition et esprit d'équipe

data.title: Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights
data.description:
We are growing! We are currently looking to hire a Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights.  

About CXG:

Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide.

The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation.

We are passionate about delivering impact.

Our clients include the world's most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction.

We are looking for a thought leadership expert with the editorial vision to spot what matters next, the conviction to shape CXG's point of view, and the writing talent to make it influential across luxury retail, beauty and cosmetics, watches and jewellery, automotive, and hospitality.

Context and role

Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will lead CXG's Thought Leadership and Market Intelligence functions. You will define the topics on which CXG should have a distinctive and credible point of view, turn CXG's proprietary data, expertise and market knowledge into original external content, and position the company ahead of emerging developments in customer experience, luxury and its priority verticals.

This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. You will be accountable for ensuring that every publication presents a recognisable CXG angle rather than simply reporting market developments or repeating established industry views. You will manage one Market Intelligence team member.

Thought Leadership Development

  • Define the thought leadership strategy and roadmap, including priority themes, target audiences, formats and a realistic publication calendar.
  • Drive and coordinate content creation across Practices, Solutions and Regions.
  • Work closely with Practices, Regions and Solutions to:
    • Push: scan for trends and hot topics and ensure CXG has a voice and perspective, commenting regularly on these subjects.
    • Pull: identify and collect new ideas and proposed topics from the relevant stakeholders, prioritise and incorporate them into the thought leadership roadmap.
  • Use market intelligence, CXG's proprietary data, internal expertise and client-facing insights to identify emerging topics early, develop a clear CXG point of view and decide where CXG can make a credible contribution to the conversation.
  • Research, interview internal experts, write and edit articles, perspectives and other thought leadership content directly. Challenge generic claims and ensure each piece advances a clear argument and is supported by credible evidence.
  • Ensure that analysis is methodologically sound, appropriately contextualised and presented without compromising client confidentiality.
  • Develop topics that connect expertise across Practices and Regions, while reflecting relevant differences between markets.

Thought Leadership Communication

  • Ensure relevant thought leadership pieces (e.g., perspectives, publications) are disseminated on a periodic basis.
  • Work with Marketing on the publication, distribution and promotion of content, while retaining ownership of the editorial strategy, substance, quality and consistency of CXG's point of view. In addition, collaborate with Marketing to maximise impact by communicating through the channels relevant to each market.
  • Track the reach, engagement and qualitative response generated by CXG's thought leadership, as well as relevant business enquiries influenced by published content. Use the findings to refine the roadmap.
  • Shape and host or contribute to CXG's podcast "The Luxury Edit", working with internal experts and guests to develop topics, prepare interviews and turn conversations into useful content.
  • Develop the content and key messages for CXG-hosted events and external conferences, panels and talks; act as a CXG speaker where appropriate; and work with internal experts to prepare other CXG speakers and turn the company's point of view into compelling presentations and discussion topics.
  • Look for and test new thought leadership formats (e.g., interactive reports, data visualisations, short-form video, newsletters, social-first content) to broaden reach, engage new audiences and keep CXG's content distinctive.
  • Identify and build collaborations with conferences, specialised industry magazines and universities (e.g., content partnerships, guest articles, co-branded publications, joint research, guest lectures, speaking slots) to extend CXG's visibility and credibility with target audiences.

Market Intelligence

  • Keep abreast of market and competitive developments and ensure relevant findings are communicated across CXG.
  • Translate these findings into clear implications for CXG's strategic priorities, client conversations, commercial opportunities and external thought leadership.
  • Contribute market intelligence, evidence and relevant CXG perspectives to priority proposals and client deliverables, working with Practices, Solutions and Regions to strengthen the quality and relevance of the final output.
  • Manage and develop the Market Intelligence team member, setting clear priorities and reviewing the quality and usefulness of their work.

Competitive Analysis

  • Develop and continuously update a list of CXG competitors.
  • Research competitor performance, including revenues and market share where reliable information is available.
  • Identify and assess the impact of new competitors' offerings.
  • Review competitors' thought leadership, influence and presence.
  • Identify gaps in the conversations competitors are leading and opportunities for CXG to establish a distinct position.

Industry Analysis

  • Research and review clients' developments (e.g., new strategy, launch of new product or service, restructuring, M&A, key managerial appointments).
  • Track public financial announcements (e.g., quarterly and annual earnings).
  • Monitor developments in luxury, retail, customer experience and adjacent sectors; distinguish lasting shifts from short-lived topics and explain their implications for CXG and its clients.
  • Publish the weekly "This Week in Luxury" news brief and issue timely flash updates when significant developments require immediate attention, such as financial announcements, major transactions or leadership changes.

Internal Dissemination and Application

  • Synthesise research and findings into concise, actionable outputs tailored to the needs of relevant internal stakeholders. Feed findings into the Thought Leadership roadmap.
  • Proactively bring relevant market signals to Practices, Regions and leadership early enough to inform decisions, client conversations and potential cross-practice opportunities.
  • Disseminate new thought leadership across CXG and equip Practices, Regions and client-facing teams with the key messages and supporting materials needed to use it in client conversations and commercial activities.

Requirements

What will you bring along?

    • Proven experience developing thought leadership, editorial content or insight-led communications in a consulting, research, customer experience, retail or luxury environment.
    • Excellent English writing and editing skills, with a portfolio demonstrating original, well-argued, evidence-led articles or publications written personally. If possible, include examples that turn proprietary research, data or specialist expertise into a distinctive point of view. Additional languages (e.g., French, Mandarin) are a plus.
    • Strong oral communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to represent CXG as a speaker at conferences, panels and client events.
    • Proven ability to build relationships and influence senior stakeholders across functions and regions without direct authority.
    • An established network or demonstrated ability to build partnerships with media, conference organisers, academic institutions or industry bodies.
    • Comfort working with quantitative data and research methods, and the ability to translate data into clear, credible narratives and visualisations.
    • Ability to define and track content performance indicators and use them to refine editorial priorities.
    • Strong research and analytical skills: able to assess sources critically, connect market signals and form a clear point of view rather than simply summarise trends.
    • Familiarity with AI-assisted research and content tools, used with appropriate rigour.
    • Sound knowledge of luxury, retail and customer experience, and curiosity about how these sectors are evolving across markets.
    • Ability to interview senior experts, challenge ideas constructively and turn specialist knowledge into accessible, credible content.
    • Comfort working independently in a remote setting, managing an editorial roadmap and delivering finished work without a large production team.
    • Experience managing or coaching at least one team member.
    • Confidence preparing and hosting interviews or podcasts is a plus.

Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own

  • Member support: Resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat, email and phone, with warmth, precision and a sense of urgency.

  • Phone-first when it matters: Pick up the phone whenever a situation calls for a human voice: a delayed result, a stressful moment, a confused member.

  • Know your boundaries: Work hand in hand with our medical team and know exactly when to escalate a health question rather than answer it yourself.

  • Voice of the member: Spot recurring issues and turn them into clear, structured feedback for the product and ops teams.

  • Contribute to projects: Take part in initiatives that improve the member experience, like rebuilding our Help Center, designing proactive care for lab delays, or automating repetitive workflows with AI.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • Experience: 1+ years in B2C customer care, support, hospitality, or any role where you dealt directly with customers. Strong recent graduates with relevant experience are welcome too.

  • Bilingual: Fluent in both English and French, written and spoken.

  • People-first energy: You bring genuine warmth and empathy to every interaction, and you turn routine support into memorable experiences.

  • Rigorous precision: Exceptional attention to detail, with zero tolerance for misquotes, wrong information or operational errors. In health, accuracy is care.

  • Builder mindset: When something breaks twice, your instinct is to fix the root cause, not just the ticket.

Nice to have

  • Support tooling: You've used Intercom or similar support tools.

  • AI automation: You've already used AI tools to automate part of your work.

  • Startup mindset: You thrive in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution and clear communication.

 

The process

  • Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

  • Case study interview (30-60 min)

  • Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

  • Reference calls

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

data.title: Head of Security
data.description:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location:

Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team).

About the role:

As Head of Security, you'll define and drive Morpho's security strategy across the entire organization - corporate IT, cloud and infrastructure, application, supply chain, identity, incident response, threat intelligence, and counterparty security - and you'll build the team and function to deliver it. This is a hands-on leadership role: in the early days you'll personally do the work while you hire, and you'll stay close enough to the technical detail to earn the trust of a deeply technical organization. You'll also be Morpho's credible security voice, internally to leadership, and externally to the integrators, institutions, and ecosystem partners who depend on us. You'll partner closely with Engineering on infrastructure and deployment integrity, and with our Integration team, which works with various partners across the Morpho ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and continuously evolve Morpho's security strategy and roadmap across, cloud/infrastructure, application, supply-chain, identity, and operational security.

  • Build and lead the security function - hire, grow, and develop the team, recruiting skillsets across security operations and application security.

  • Oversight of the IT function

  • Stay hands-on. Personally execute critical security work - threat modeling, architecture review, control implementation, and incident command - while the team scales.

  • Set the governance architecture: a coherent security framework that ties tooling and controls together, rather than accumulating tools in isolation.

  • Own incident response end to end - runbooks, incident command, severity and escalation structure, and market communication during an event.

  • Build and run a counterparty security program for curators and partners - identity verification, screening, operational diligence, and bidirectional incident-coordination channels.

  • Lead Morpho's certification strategy (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001), meeting both the spirit and the letter sustainably.

  • Represent Morpho's security posture externally - to fintechs, financial institutions, and the broader ecosystem - and internally to executives.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations, driving security outcomes through both direct ownership and influence.

What Success Looks Like:

First 30 Days

  • You've built a clear, independent picture of Morpho's posture, architecture, threat model, and in-flight work - and pressure-tested the existing strategy against it.

  • You've met the team and established working relationships with the people who own the surfaces you'll most depend on.

  • You understand the path-to-funds attack surface in depth and have an early, evidence-based view of the highest-severity risks and quick wins.

  • You know exactly where incident-response readiness stands today.

First 60 Days

  • You've published a clearly prioritized security roadmap with clear sequencing, owners, and the rationale for what's deferred and aligned leadership behind it.

  • You've defined the team build-out plan and opened the first hire.

  • You're personally driving the top-severity gaps - identity and authentication enforcement, deployment guardrails, and a documented incident-response runbook among them.

  • You've set the governance framework and the certification path in motion.

First 90 Days

  • Demonstrable progress closing the highest-priority gaps, with key controls enforced rather than optional.

  • A documented incident-response capability that's been validated by at least one tabletop exercise.

  • Hiring underway, and a clear operating rhythm established with Engineering, Protocol, and Integrations.

  • Morpho's external security posture is taking shape - trust surface, counterparty security program, and ecosystem engagement - and you're recognized internally and externally as Morpho's credible security voice.

Must-have Experience & Skills:

  • 10+ years in security, several of them building or leading a security function, ideally at a crypto/web3, fintech, or financial-services company where security is core to the business.

  • Strong grasp of the crypto/web3 threat model

  • Proven experience building and growing a security team from a small base, recruiting across security operations and application/infrastructure security.

  • Deep, hands-on technical expertise across cloud, infrastructure, CI/CD, supply-chain, identity, and application security - you do the work, not just direct it.

  • Owned incident response end to end, including incident command and external communication.

  • Sharp prioritization and the ability to galvanize action through hard and soft influence, including driving outcomes through teams you don't own.

  • Exceptional, organized, responsive communication - credible to executives and to external audiences from fintechs to Fortune 500 institutions.

  • Humble.

Nice to Have:

  • An established network and public profile in the security or crypto-security community, and comfort representing security work publicly (talks, writing, framework contribution).

  • Offensive security depth, or experience standing up red/blue capabilities.

  • Familiarity with institutional and regulatory expectations and threat-sharing networks (e.g. Crypto ISAC, TIBER-style frameworks).

  • Taken an organization through certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or equivalent)

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

data.title: Finance Manager, Financial Control & Accounting
data.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

💰 Our Finance team

The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management.

We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently.

As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting), and Procurement. This role anchors Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) — the pole that keeps Joko's financial information accurate, timely, and audit-ready. You'll report directly to Quentin, our COO.

 

✨ Why this role is special

Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) is a brand-new specialized pole at Joko — previously bundled into a single generalist Finance Manager role. You'll be the first person to own this scope end to end, with direct visibility to the COO and VP Finance with real influence over how the function is built as the company scales past 200 people across multiple geographies.

  • You set the standards, not just follow them: as the pole's first hire, the processes, controls, and calendar you establish now become the backbone the rest of Finance builds on.

  • A true partner in automation: you'll work hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated — this isn't a role where you're expected to grind through manual work alone.

  • International scope from day one: France, the US, and future markets — you'll help build the multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as Joko expands.

 

🎯 What you will do

As Finance Manager, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting), your main mission is to own the reliability, timeliness, and completeness of Joko's financial information. Rather than doing the bookkeeping — we have an external accounting partner for that — you set the standards, drive the calendar, and hold your internal and external stakeholders accountable.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Drive the closing calendar: own the monthly and annual closing calendar, holding our external accounting partner and auditors to a high standard;

  • Own our legal reporting package: make sure the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement are always accurate and delivered on time;

  • Oversee AP/AR end to end: keep invoicing, payment runs, and collections under control;

  • Lead our international accounting build-out: as we open new entities and markets, including our IFRS consolidation framework;

  • Own cash management: reconciliation, yield optimization, and day-to-day treasury;

  • Be the main point of contact for our banking and accounting partners, and a key interface for auditors as we scale toward IPO readiness;

  • Continuously strengthen and document our financial processes and controls, working hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated, making everything more robust and less error-prone as the company scales.

 

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: 4–8 years, with a strong foundation in accounting or audit (Big 4 or equivalent), ideally combined with in-house experience in a scale-up.

  • Education: A master's degree from a top business school. A double degree in accounting (DCG/DSCG) is a plus.

  • Financial rigor: Deep understanding of French GAAP and treasury fundamentals — you bring the same discipline to a closing cycle as you do to a cash position.

  • International mindset: Excited to build a multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as we expand; IFRS exposure is a plus.

  • Stakeholder management: You build trust with partners inside and outside Joko, and you're comfortable holding them accountable.

  • Problem solving: You dig into the root cause and fix things.

  • AI centricity: You use AI in your daily work today, and you're excited to help automate reporting and reconciliation as part of Joko's AI-first finance ambition.

  • Languages: Fluent French and English.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


Position description

We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join the CI Experience squad within our Code Orchestration department.

The CI Experience squad enables users to analyze their projects in their own CI, making analysis a core part of their workflow. We have a mission to make analysis reliable, fast, configurable and developer-friendly.

 

What you will do

data.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
data.description:
IN SHORT

Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory.
  • Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites.
  • Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations.
  • Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet.
  • Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team.
  • Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software.
  • Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first.
  • Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans.
  • Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup.


YOUR PROFILE

  • Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework.
  • Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait.
  • Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin.
  • Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code.
  • Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers.
  • High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end.
  • Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus.
  • Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.
  • Valid work permit or Swiss passport.


OUR BENEFITS

  • Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true
  • Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine
  • 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation 
  • Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day
  • We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund
  • New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.
  • We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard
  • Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing
  • Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions
 
Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.


ABOUT US

FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. 
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

You set clear expectations for execution methods, field quality controls, and turnover documentation needed for safe operation and maintenance.

  • System Reliability & Innovation: You lead initiatives to improve reliability and performance of Electrical systems, troubleshoot issues, and implement preventive measures. You evaluate and introduce emerging technologies such as energy efficiency solutions.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: You act as the primary Electrical interface with process, instrumentation and controls, mechanical, and project management teams to ensure integrated designs. You identify and mitigate Electrical risks during design and operation phases and support project teams with scope, cost, and schedule estimates.

  • Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement: You supervise and coach junior team members, provide guidance on technical challenges, and drive lessons-learned sessions to maintain a strong knowledge base and promote continuous improvement.  You maintain thorough records of technical decisions, design bases, vendor information, and lessons learned for future operational use.

  • Cold-Weather and Constructability: As our next DAC plant could be in a cold or hot weather environment, you incorporate climate conditions into the Electrical design and execution planning (extreme heat, freeze protection, winterization, insulation/heat tracing philosophy, cold start/commissioning constraints). You ensure the design is constructable and able to operate and be maintained through cold or hot conditions, including consideration of temporary works, for instance winter work sequencing, and interface constraints with cold-weather activities.


  • Professional Experience: You have a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent and have at least 10 years of experience in process plants various climates as an Electrical Engineer.  You have experience leading teams.

  • Project Experience: You have hands-on involvement in at least one full-cycle project in the mining, water treatment, oil and gas or other comparable industries, covering all phases from FEED and detailed design to construction, commissioning and start-up; preferably in remote/seasonally constrained execution environments.  You have expertise in low and medium voltage electrical systems, industrial instrumentation, and control systems.

  • Cold-Weather Industrial Plant Experience: You have hands-on experience working with industrial plants in cold-weather environments (e.g. Canada, Nordic countries, or similar climates) and understand the operational, maintenance, and safety challenges associated with extreme weather conditions.

  • Communication & Collaboration: You demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills and can liaise with diverse stakeholders, including third-party vendors in IP-sensitive collaborations.

We are a rapidly growing embodied AI company revolutionizing human labor. Leveraging cutting-edge robotics and advanced artificial intelligence, we develop transformative technologies that redefine how work is done across multiple industries—empowering businesses to streamline operations, boost productivity, and unlock new possibilities.

Overview:

We are looking for a world-class robotics professionals to join our R&D hub in the Zurich area. In this role, you will be at the forefront of developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that enable robots to understand and interact with the world with unprecedented generalization. You will work on the intersection of large-scale foundation models and real-world robotic execution, bridging the gap between state-of-the-art research and deployed embodied intelligence.

Your Responsibilities:

Research & Development:

  • Design, implement, and scale VLA models and foundation architectures for robotic manipulation and navigation.

Professional Background:

  • Experience working in leading AI research environments

Technical Mastery:

  • Deep expertise in PyTorch or JAX, experience with Transformers, Diffusion Models, and Large Language Models (LLMs).

Domain Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Vision-Language models and their application to Action/Control loops in robotics.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in Switzerland.

As an Account Executive, you will drive business growth across Europe by selling cutting-edge cloud infrastructure technology to enterprise customers, cloud providers, and fast-growing AI and developer platforms. You will own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to technical evaluations, pilot programs, commercial negotiations, and closing deals. Working closely with the founding team and technical experts, you will help customers understand how next-generation microvirtualization can improve workload isolation, security, and infrastructure efficiency. You will build a qualified pipeline through strategic outbound campaigns, industry networking, and targeted account development. As an early sales hire, you will have a direct influence on the go-to-market strategy, sales processes, and future growth of the commercial organization. This fully remote opportunity combines entrepreneurial ownership, technical learning, and uncapped earning potential in a rapidly evolving AI and cloud infrastructure market.


Accountabilities

  • Build, manage, and grow a European sales pipeline targeting enterprise infrastructure teams, cloud and hosting providers, and high-growth AI and developer technology companies.

  • Own the full sales cycle, from identifying and qualifying prospects to conducting discovery calls, coordinating technical evaluations, negotiating commercial terms, and securing signed contracts.

  • Develop and execute targeted outbound strategies in collaboration with go-to-market engineers, identifying priority accounts, key decision-makers, and effective messaging to generate qualified opportunities.

  • Lead customer conversations and engage economic buyers early, building relationships with CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security teams, procurement professionals, and other stakeholders involved in complex purchasing decisions.

  • Implement and operate the security controls assigned to IT, maintain evidence and remediation plans, and work with the Security Office on incidents, risks and exceptions.

  • Work with R&D and Data Science on agreed infrastructure and integrations. Those teams retain ownership of DevOps and MLOps.

  • Plan and deliver IT services for new locations, including remote support, local hands, equipment logistics and coordination with Security and Facilities.

  • Own the IT budget and supplier relationships, and ensure that external partners complement internal accountability and knowledge.

  • Lead the disentanglement of interconnected IT services and dependencies, establishing clear ownership while protecting continuity and ensuring controlled handovers.

  • Use service performance, workload, risks and skills data to guide recruitment, training and investment, and communicate progress clearly to management.

What we offer

  • The opportunity to shape and scale the IT organisation of an international deep-tech company.

  • Meaningful responsibility for the team, services, architecture and investments within your remit.

  • A competitive salary and benefits package.

  • An international working environment with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities.

  • Regular team activities, company events and fresh team lunches three times per week.


What you bring

We care more about what you can do than how you got there. We welcome strong candidates from different educational and career backgrounds.

  • You have led an IT function or multidisciplinary technical team through growth and understand how to build capacity before services become overstretched.

  • You have managed specialists across infrastructure, applications and end-user support and know how to create clear ownership without losing collaboration.

  • You lead through coaching, practical support and honest feedback, and you invest in your team's professional development.

  • You are comfortable across a modern hybrid environment, including Microsoft 365, Azure and Entra ID, on-premises infrastructure, networking, endpoint management, backup and recovery.

  • You do not need to be the deepest expert in every domain, but you can challenge designs, ask the right questions and make credible technical decisions.

  • You have practical experience with IT service management, enterprise applications, integrations, architecture and technology roadmaps.

  • You have owned budgets and supplier relationships and can make clear trade-offs between service, risk, cost and capacity.

  • You have worked in, or can quickly adapt to, an environment where security, compliance and defence obligations shape how IT operates.

  • You communicate clearly in English with technical teams, business owners and senior management. Dutch is an advantage.

  • Nice to have

  • Experience with manufacturing IT, operational technology or segregated production networks.

  • Experience with operational IT services used in customer products or customer environments.

Security and compliance

This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements. data.title: Senior Embedded Software Test Engineer
data.description:
As a Senior Embedded Software Test Engineer at Optics11, you own the embedded software system-test capability for our sensing interrogator platforms. You define, automate, execute, and continuously improve Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and box-level integration and regression testing so that software and firmware release candidates are qualified on representative hardware before they move downstream to formal verification, FAT (Factory Acceptance Test), field, or application validation.

Your scope covers the integrated behavior of embedded Linux applications and services, internal and external APIs, hardware interfaces, firmware and FPGA interactions, system control, calibration and configuration, diagnostics, data acquisition, boot and update behavior, recovery mechanisms, and sensor interfaces. You build and maintain automated test frameworks, HIL benches, test harnesses, CI/CD integration, and objective release evidence that make product behavior repeatable, observable, and measurable.

You are part of the Sensing Platform Team and work closely with Embedded Software, FPGA/Firmware, Electronics, Photonics, Architects, Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, application/software teams, and external development partners. The primary ownership of this role is integrated interrogator/HIL system-level testing and release qualification. It complements developer-owned unit and component testing and does not replace independent formal verification, compliance, environmental, or end-to-end application validation performed downstream.

Key Responsibilities:

  • HIL & System-Level Test Development

    • Own the interrogator/HIL test strategy, system-level regression suite, and embedded software/firmware release qualification approach for the Sensing Platform.

    • Translate product, software, firmware, and interface requirements into test plans, acceptance criteria, coverage objectives, and automated regression tests.

    • Design, build, and maintain HIL test setups using representative hardware, simulated or real sensor inputs, and remotely controlled lab equipment.

    • Develop maintainable Python-based test automation for device control, test orchestration, data capture, analysis, and reporting.

    • Integrate hardware-based regression testing into CI/CD pipelines, enabling repeatable and largely automated testing of release candidates.

    • Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, results, and release evidence.

  • Release Qualification & Failure Analysis

    • Qualify embedded software and firmware releases on representative interrogator hardware before downstream V&V, FAT, field, or application validation.

    • Design and execute system, negative, stress, endurance, fault-injection, restart/recovery, upgrade/rollback, and robustness testing based on product risk.

    • Analyze logs, system state, performance, timing, communication behavior, and data outputs to identify regressions and integration issues.

    • Triage failures and support root-cause analysis across software, firmware, FPGA, electronics, photonics, sensors, and system interfaces.

    • Reproduce field, production, and customer issues in laboratory/HIL environments and turn important failures into permanent regression coverage.

    • Provide clear, evidence-based input on release readiness, known limitations, unresolved defects, and coverage gaps.

  • Test Engineering & Technical Ownership

    • Identify quality risks, missing coverage, weak observability, testability limitations, and failure scenarios, and drive practical improvements.

    • Evaluate test frameworks, HIL architectures, simulation approaches, instrumentation, and automation solutions.

    • Work with Software, Firmware/FPGA, Electronics, Photonics, Systems, Integration and V&V engineers to improve design-for-testability, interfaces, diagnostics, and acceptance criteria.

    • Own significant HIL, system-test, and automation workstreams with minimal guidance, while keeping test environments, tooling, configurations, and documentation reliable and reproducible.

    • Contribute to requirement, design, code, test-plan, and test-result reviews.

  • Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

    • Collaborate across multidisciplinary engineering teams to solve complex integration and product-quality issues.

    • Communicate test results, quality risks, defects, dependencies, and release readiness clearly to technical stakeholders.

    • Share knowledge and mentor peers in embedded software testing, HIL automation, failure analysis, and robust test design.

    • Continuously improve automated coverage, CI/CD quality gates, test reporting, diagnostics, test-environment stability, and release processes.

    • Reduce flaky, manual, and repetitive testing through reusable test assets and reliable automation.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided every day.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or related technical discipline.

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in embedded software testing, embedded systems integration, test automation, HIL testing, software quality engineering, or related fields.

Strong experience testing embedded products on physical hardware and integrated systems throughout the product-development lifecycle.

  • Strong Python skills for test automation, tooling, laboratory equipment control, and analysis.

  • Strong understanding of embedded Linux systems, Linux applications and services, software processes, networking, logging/diagnostics, and hardware/software interaction.

  • Hands-on experience designing or maintaining automated test harnesses, HIL or system-level test environments, and regression suites for embedded products.

  • Experience with automated test frameworks such as pytest, Robot Framework, or comparable tools; Git; Linux; Docker; and CI/CD systems such as GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar.

  • Experience testing software APIs, hardware interfaces, inter-process communication, system-control functionality, data acquisition, and integrated embedded-system behavior.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience applying structured test design, defect triage, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis methods.

  • Experience debugging complex issues across software, firmware, FPGA, electronics, and hardware boundaries using logs, traces, diagnostics, and laboratory equipment.

  • Strong communication skills in English and the ability to explain technical findings and product-quality risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Eligible for required EU/NATO/security screening or clearance, where applicable to the role.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in multidisciplinary high-tech product development involving software, firmware, electronics, FPGA, photonics, sensing, manufacturing, or defense/security applications.

  • Experience with laboratory automation and instrumentation, for example programmable power supplies, function generators, switching/multiplexing equipment, serial interfaces, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or LabVIEW-based setups.

  • Experience with SIL, simulation, device emulation, or virtualized test environments that complement physical HIL testing.

  • ISTQB, or comparable test certification, is a plus, but hands-on embedded test-engineering experience is more important.

  • Experience designing fault-injection, endurance, recovery, power-cycle, upgrade/rollback, and robustness tests for embedded systems.

  • Familiarity with systems engineering, product verification, requirement traceability, configuration management, and product lifecycle management processes.

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

  • Een gezellige werksfeer en een heerlijke, verzorgde lunch op kantoor;

  • Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten;

  • 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding;

  • De mogelijkheid om je stage af te sluiten met een concrete showcase- of portfolio-project.

Functievereisten

  • Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding in bijvoorbeeld AI, ICT, Informatica, Business IT of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Ervaring met API-koppelingen en databases is mooi meegenomen;

  • Je hebt basiskennis van programmeren en vindt het leuk om hierin verder te leren;

  • Zelfstandig werken gaat je goed af en je neemt graag zelf initiatief;

  • Je kunt goed communiceren in het Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.


Over Flagship

Flagship Amsterdam is een jonge en snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers.

Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan unieke events en creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

data.title: Teamleider ICT & Security (m/v/x)
data.description:
DNW zoekt een teamleider die ICT en security samenbrengt: iemand die zorgt dat onze medewerkers goed kunnen werken, onze systemen betrouwbaar beschikbaar zijn en onze informatie veilig blijft.

Wat ga je doen?

Je geeft leiding aan het team ICT & Security en bent verantwoordelijk voor de integrale aansturing van ICT en het organisatie brede security domein (Duitsland en Nederland). Je zorgt voor een samenhangende aanpak van fysieke beveiliging, informatiebeveiliging en IT-/cybersecurity in lijn met ISO 27001, wet- en regelgeving en de organisatiedoelstellingen.

Op locaties Marknesse en Amsterdam levert je team lokale ICT ondersteuning. Op onze locaties in Duitsland wordt die lokale ondersteuning verzorgt binnen de lokale windtunnel teams waarmee doelmatig samengewerkt wordt. ICT binnen DNW omvat naast reguliere kantoortoepassingen ook een uitgebreid en complex netwerk van faciliteit gebonden meet- en regelsystemen en data-acquisitiesystemen die 24/7 operationeel moeten blijven.

Je combineert leiderschap met inhoudelijke kennis van ICT en security en bent een belangrijke gesprekspartner voor management en medewerkers.

Verantwoordelijkheden van het team:

·        Beheer, licenties en onderhoud van computers, software en mobiele apparatuur;

·        Netwerk en technische ICT-ondersteuning (incl. windtunnel testomgeving, data backup incl. meetdata);

·        Cybersecurity en informatiebeveiliging. Data security en privacy. Binnen het team zijn ook de rollen Security Officer (DWN breed NL + DE)  en IT Security Officer (locaties Amsterdam en Marknesse)  gepositioneerd.

Specifieke verantwoordelijkheden van de teamleider:

·        Aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van het team.

·        Ontwikkelen, adviseren over en uitvoeren van de ICT- en securityvisie en -strategie.

·        Zorgen voor de randvoorwaarden waarbinnen de Security Officer en IT Security Officer hun verantwoordelijkheden onafhankelijk en effectief kunnen uitvoeren.

·        Coördineren van ICT- en securityprojecten en verbetertrajecten inclusief afstemming met alle stakeholders binnen DNW, inclusief de Duitse locaties.

·        Zorgen voor passende processen rondom incidenten, wijzigingen en risico’s binnen de organisatie.

·        Bewaken van de aansluiting op relevante wet- en regelgeving en interne beleidskaders.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een verbindende en resultaatgerichte teamleider die begrijpt dat ICT en security geen doel op zich zijn, maar randvoorwaarden voor een goed functionerende organisatie.

Je combineert een mensgerichte leiderschapsstijl met voldoende inhoudelijke kennis en organisatiesensitiviteit. Je kunt gemakkelijk schakelen tussen strategische vraagstukken en de dagelijkse praktijk. Je weet complexe ICT- en securityvraagstukken terug te brengen tot heldere keuzes en concrete acties.

Je bent proactief, besluitvaardig en communicatief sterk. Je durft risico’s en knelpunten bespreekbaar te maken, maar kijkt daarbij altijd naar haalbare oplossingen. Je geeft medewerkers vertrouwen en verantwoordelijkheid en creëert een omgeving waarin mensen zich kunnen ontwikkelen.

Je begrijpt dat ICT & Security in een operationele testomgeving behoefte heeft aan een flexibele on-site ondersteuning.

Je hebt bovendien oog voor het bredere belang van de organisatie. Je begrijpt dat goede ICT-dienstverlening draait om continuïteit en gebruiksgemak, maar dat dit altijd in balans moet zijn met veiligheid, privacy, compliance en kosten.

data.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
data.description:
Als Senior Machine Learning Engineer bij BigData Republic combineer je diepgaande technische expertise met consultancy. Je ontwikkelt niet alleen machine-learningoplossingen, maar brengt ze daadwerkelijk naar productie en adviseert klanten over architectuur, technologie en de beste aanpak om duurzame businesswaarde te realiseren.

Voor deze senior positie zoeken we een ervaren professional met minimaal 6 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met machine learning in professionele productieomgevingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Machine Learning Engineering bevindt zich bij BigData Republic op het snijvlak van Machine Learning, MLOps, Software Engineering, Data Engineering en Cloud Engineering.

Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams bij klanten aan end-to-end machine-learningoplossingen: van probleemdefinitie en architectuur tot ontwikkeling, deployment, monitoring en optimalisatie.

Je;

  • analyseert complexe business- en technische vraagstukken en vertaalt deze naar robuuste ML-oplossingen;

  • adviseert klanten en stakeholders over machine learning, MLOps, architectuur en technische keuzes;

  • ontwikkelt en productionaliseert machine-learningmodellen;

  • ontwerpt schaalbare ML- en MLOps-architecturen;

  • bouwt production-grade software rondom machine-learningoplossingen;

  • werkt aan deployment, CI/CD, model serving, monitoring en observability;

  • werkt samen met Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Software Engineers en Cloud Engineers;

  • helpt klanten en collega's inhoudelijk naar een hoger niveau;

  • draagt actief bij aan kennisdeling en thought leadership binnen BigData Republic.

De technische uitdagingen variëren van machine-learningmodellen met directe businessimpact tot toepassingen rond deep learning, generative AI, Large Language Models (LLM's), predictive modelling, causal inference en reinforcement learning.

Bij BigData Republic zien we een machine-learningmodel niet als het eindproduct. Een model levert pas waarde wanneer het betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en beheersbaar in productie draait. Daarom benaderen we ML-oplossingen als volwaardige softwareproducten.

Technologieën waarmee we veel werken zijn onder andere;

  • Python

  • Airflow

  • Apache Spark

  • Kafka

  • Docker

  • Tensorflow

  • Pytorch

  • Kubernetes

  • Terraform

  • AWS/ Azur/ GCP en private-cloud omgevingen


Welke technologie je inzet, hangt af van het vraagstuk. We zoeken daarom geen engineer die simpelweg zoveel mogelijk tools kent, maar een ervaren professional die begrijpt welke technische oplossing in welke situatie passend is en waarom.

Je werkt aan complexe data-, AI- en machine-learningvraagstukken voor grote organisaties in verschillende sectoren. Tegelijkertijd ben je onderdeel van een klein, informeel en inhoudelijk gedreven team van ervaren Machine Learning Engineers, MLOps Engineers, Data Engineers en Data Scientists.

Kennisdeling en thought leadership zijn fundamentele onderdelen van BigData Republic. We organiseren iedere vrijdag kennissessies op kantoor, schrijven inhoudelijke artikelen, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om je eigen expertise verder te ontwikkelen en tegelijkertijd collega's en klanten verder te helpen.


Dit is nadrukkelijk een senior consultancyrol. Om succesvol te kunnen zijn in deze functie zoeken we iemand die beschikt over:

  • minimaal 6 jaar relevante professionele werkervaring binnen software engineering, data engineering, data science en/of machine learning;

  • minimaal 3 jaar hands-on professionele ervaring met machine learning, waarbij je aantoonbaar ML-oplossingen naar productie hebt gebracht en beheerd, verbeterd of opgeschaald;

  • ervaring met het zelfstandig analyseren van complexe technische vraagstukken en het adviseren van klanten en stakeholders over oplossingen, architectuur en technische keuzes;

  • ruime professionele programmeerervaring met Python;

  • gedegen kennis van software-engineeringprincipes en ervaring met het bouwen van production-grade oplossingen;

  • ervaring met minimaal één grote cloudomgeving: AWS, Azure en/of GCP;

  • ervaring met MLOps, waaronder deployment, CI/CD, monitoring, observability en schaalbaarheid;

  • academisch werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied;

  • uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands (minimaal C1) en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Daarnaast is het van toegevoegde waarde als je ervaring hebt met:

  • consultancy binnen complexe enterprise-omgevingen;

  • solution architecture of technical leadership;

  • Kubernetes en Terraform;

  • Spark, Kafka en/of Airflow;

  • TensorFlow en/of PyTorch;

  • generative AI en Large Language Models (LLM's);

  • deep learning, causal inference of reinforcement learning;

  • Scala, Kotlin en/of SQL;

  • open-sourceprojecten, meetups, conferenties of andere vormen van kennisdeling.

We verwachten niet dat je met iedere technologie uit onze stack hebt gewerkt. De senioriteit van je ervaring, het daadwerkelijk in productie brengen van machine-learningoplossingen, je vermogen om klanten inhoudelijk te adviseren en je beheersing van het Nederlands zijn voor deze rol wel essentieel.

Je bent technisch sterk, maar kijkt verder dan alleen de technologie. Je kunt complexe situaties doorgronden, alternatieven afwegen en uitleggen waarom een bepaalde oplossing wel of niet verstandig is. Je voelt je comfortabel in gesprekken met engineers, architecten en business stakeholders.

Tegelijkertijd blijf je graag zelf bouwen. BigData Republic zoekt geen consultant die alleen vanaf de zijlijn adviseert: je combineert senior technisch advies met hands-on Machine Learning Engineering.

data.title: Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter
data.description:
Bouw mee aan recruitment voor een hoogwaardige tech consultancy

Senior tech professionals vinden vraagt meer dan vacatures publiceren en sollicitaties beoordelen. De beste kandidaten zijn vaak niet actief op zoek. Je moet weten waar je ze vindt, hoe je ze benadert en hoe je ze enthousiast maakt voor een inhoudelijk gesprek.

Bij Conflux zoeken we daarom een Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter die recruitment en sourcing beheerst. Iemand die zelfstandig de arbeidsmarkt benadert, hiring managers adviseert en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor het volledige recruitmentproces.

Conflux is een Nederlandse tech consultancy met gespecialiseerde expertise binnen onder andere Data & AI, Software Development, Cloud en Platform Engineering. Onze consultants werken aan complexe technische vraagstukken en behoren inhoudelijk tot de ervaren professionals binnen hun vakgebied.

Dat betekent dat onze recruitment vraagstukken niet eenvoudig zijn. We zoeken onder andere Senior Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Java Developers, Kubernetes Engineers, Platform Engineers en Front-end Developers.

Daarvoor zoeken we een recruiter die zijn of haar vak verstaat.

Wat je gaat doen

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de werving van ervaren technische consultants binnen onder andere:

  • Data Engineering & AI

  • Machine Learning

  • Java Development

  • Kubernetes & Cloud Native

  • Cloud & Platform Engineering

  • Front-end Development

Je beheert het recruitmentproces van arbeidsmarktanalyse en sourcing tot selectie en aanbieding.

Concreet betekent dit dat je:

  • actief technische professionals sourcet en benadert, onder andere via LinkedIn Recruiter en andere sourcingkanalen;

  • zelfstandig searches en sourcingstrategieën ontwikkelt voor moeilijk vindbare doelgroepen;

  • kandidaten screent op ervaring, technische context, motivatie en consultancy-fit;

  • hiring managers adviseert over doelgroep, haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, selectiecriteria en recruitmentaanpak;

  • kandidaten gedurende het volledige proces begeleidt en zorgt voor een professionele en persoonlijke candidate experience;

  • interview- en selectieprocessen bewaakt en waar nodig bijstuurt;

  • talentpools opbouwt en relaties onderhoudt met relevante professionals;

  • data en recruitmentinzichten gebruikt om keuzes en prioriteiten te onderbouwen;

  • externe recruitmentpartners inzet wanneer dit aantoonbaar waarde toevoegt;

  • kansen signaleert om recruitment slimmer, sneller en effectiever te organiseren.

Ongeveer 85% van je tijd ben je bezig met recruitment en sourcing. De overige tijd gebruik je om recruitment verder te professionaliseren, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van tooling, data, processen, arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, AI of nieuwe sourcingmethoden.

Je bent daarmee niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor vacatures, maar mede-eigenaar van hoe recruitment binnen Conflux wordt uitgevoerd en ontwikkeld.


We zoeken nadrukkelijk een ervaren tech recruiter die zelfstandig kan opereren in een markt waarin kandidaten schaars zijn en actief gevonden en overtuigd moeten worden.

Dit breng je mee

  • Minimaal 6 jaar professionele recruitmentervaring.

  • Minimaal 4 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met IT- of tech recruitment.

  • Ervaring met het zelfstandig werven van ervaren of senior technische professionals.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met active sourcing en direct search.

  • Je weet hoe je een technische doelgroep analyseert en vertaalt naar een effectieve search- en benaderingsstrategie.

  • Je kunt inhoudelijk voldoende meepraten over technische rollen en begrijpt het verschil tussen bijvoorbeeld software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, cloud en platform engineering.

  • Je bent ervaren met LinkedIn Recruiter en weet dat goede sourcing verder gaat dan alleen LinkedIn.

  • Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor hiring managers en durft recruitmentvraagstukken kritisch te benaderen.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig prioriteiten bepalen en meerdere complexe vacatures tegelijkertijd managen.

  • Je combineert snelheid met kwaliteit en houdt grip op voortgang en candidate experience.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft professioneel Nederlands en Engels.

Ervaring met recruitment binnen tech consultancy, IT-dienstverlening, detachering of een vergelijkbare kennisintensieve omgeving is van toegevoegde waarde.

Wie jij bent

Je hebt weinig dagelijkse aansturing nodig. Je ziet waar recruitment stagneert, onderzoekt waarom en komt met oplossingen.

Je wacht niet alleen op sollicitanten, maar gaat zelf de markt in.

Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe sourcingmethoden, tooling en technologie en experimenteert graag met manieren om moeilijk bereikbare kandidaten toch te vinden.

Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat recruitment uiteindelijk draait om mensen. Je bouwt relaties op, communiceert duidelijk en zorgt ervoor dat kandidaten ook bij een afwijzing een professionele ervaring hebben.



Waarom Conflux?

Je komt terecht in een organisatie waarin recruitment dicht op de business zit. De lijnen met hiring managers en directie zijn kort en er is ruimte om vanuit jouw expertise invloed uit te oefenen op hoe we recruitment organiseren.

Je krijgt:

  • veel zelfstandigheid en vertrouwen;

  • directe invloed op recruitmentstrategie en sourcing;

  • ruimte om nieuwe sourcingmethoden en tooling te introduceren;

  • inhoudelijk sterke collega's binnen verschillende technische disciplines;

  • korte lijnen met hiring managers en directie;

  • ruimte om recruitmentprocessen daadwerkelijk te verbeteren.
